globaltix_product_data.description: Enjoy a great day out on the water watching dolphins and admiring crystal clear water in this dolphin cruise from Jervis Bay! The Dolphin Eco Tour in Jervis Bay, NSW gives you the chance to see over 100 Bottlenose Dolphins all the while spending an exceptional day out on the water. Fall in love as you watch them feed in pods on the local reef systems, or catch them swimming and racing over 100-metres to play on the bow of the vessel. Keep your eyes peeled, because you may also see Sea Turtles, Whales, Sea Eagles, and Australian Fur Seals. Enjoy the history commentary as you travel amongst the untouched beaches and pristine clear waters of the area. Jervis Bay is one of the most healthy ecosystems in all of Australia, making it an ideal place to view the beloved Bottlenose Dolphin. If you're looking for a day out as a family, then this trip is perfect! Book today.
highlights: Home to over 100 Bottlenose Dolphins

Crystal clear water
History commentary

globaltix_product_data.summary: The JR All Shikoku Area Pass is a JR transportation pass specifically for travelers with non-Japanese passports. globaltix_product_data.description: The JR All Shikoku Area Pass is a JR transportation pass specifically for travelers with non-Japanese passports. This pass allows unlimited travel on JR trains within the Shikoku region, covering areas such as Matsuyama, Kochi, Tokushima, and Takamatsu. It also includes JR Ferry Miyajima, as well as trains and trams operated by Kotoden, Iyotetsu, Tosaden, Tosa Kuroshio Railway, and Asa Kaigan Railway. Additionally, it can be used on specific ferries to Shodoshima Island and on buses within Shodoshima for three, four, five, or seven consecutive days
highlights: Choose a 3-day, 4-day, 5-day, or 7-day consecutive train pass to suit your travel needs
Ride JR trains plus trains and trams from Kotoden, Iyotetsu, Tosaden, and others
Access all four Shikoku prefectures with a single rail pass that offers unlimited travel within the specified area
inclusions: Non-reserved seats in standard cars on limited express, express, and local trains across all JR Shikoku lines and all Tosa Kuroshio Railway lines
All Asa Kaigan Railway lines, all Iyo Railway lines, all Takamatsu-Kotohira Electric Railway lines, and all Tosaden Kotsu lines
Shodoshima Ferry route between Takamatsu and Tonosho
exclusions: Sunrise Seto or Botchan Train service
Any bus routes other than the Shodoshima Olive Bus
This ticket can be used on the JR Seto-Ōhashi Line from Kojima Station southward, and in the area north of Kojima Station (toward Okayama Station)
High-speed ferry service to Shodoshima or other routes besides the Takamatsu-Tonosho route

Booking Guidelines: The name, country of residence, and passport numbers entered when booking must be an exact match to the passports used when boarding You must book your JR Pass before traveling to or entering Japan It is recommended to book the JR Pass at least 14 days before you intend to travel to Japan. The date selected above on the calendar is not the date of activation, but the date you intend to leave to Japan Once purchased, you will receive an Exchange Order. You will receive one Exchange Order per person You have 90 days - from the purchase date - to swap the Exchange Order for the actual physical JR Pass in Japan at an Official Exchange Office. Once exchanged in Japan, you have 30 days to activate your JR Pass and start travelling on the trains Pass eligibility: When three or more babies accompany one adult or child, child tickets are required for the third and any additional babies When a baby or infant occupies his or her own reserved seat, Green Car seat, berth, etc., tickets are required Valid only for non-Japanese passport holders with a "Temporary Visitor" Visa stamp on the passport. Non-Japanese passport holders with a permanent residence in Japan cannot use this product The rail pass is available only for foreign visitors who enter Japan with a non Japanese passport under the entry status of “Temporary Visitor When you exchange or purchase a rail pass at the designated station in Japan, you need to show your passport with a “Temporary Visitor” stamp/sticker (or the “registered user card” of the Trusted Traveler Program that the “Temporary Visitor” is printed) According to the Japanese Immigration Law, you are allowed to stay in Japan for 15 days or 90 days under the entry status of "Temporary Visitor" with the purpose of sightseeing, etc. If you apply for a stay with the purpose of sightseeing etc., when entering Japan, an immigration officer will put a "Temporary Visitor" stamp/sticker on your passport. Only visitors with this stamp/sticker (or visitors who have the "Temporary Visitor" printed on a "registered user card" of the Trusted Traveler Program) can use the rail pass You cannot purchase a rail pass if you enter Japan under the entry status other than “Temporary Visitor” such as “Training”, “Entertainer”, or “Re-entry” etc. The entry status of “Temporary Visitor” includes sightseeing, recreation, sports, visiting relatives, inspection tours, attending lectures or meetings, business liaison, or other similar activities If you use an automated gate, the “Temporary Visitor” stamp/sticker will not be put on your passport. Please use a manned automated gate or ask an immigration officer how you can get the stamp or the sticker.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Kecak Dance at Tanah Lot is a traditional Balinese performance held in the open air near the iconic Tanah Lot sea temple. Performed at sunset, the dance is famous for its powerful “cak-cak-cak” chanting, created by a large group of male performers sitting in a circle. Unlike most Balinese dances, Kecak uses no musical instruments—the rhythm and energy come entirely from human voices and movements. The story usually comes from the Ramayana epic, focusing on Prince Rama, Princess Sita, the demon king Ravana, and the monkey warrior Hanuman. The dramatic chanting, expressive hand gestures, and fire elements combine with the ocean and sunset backdrop, creating a memorable cultural experience. globaltix_product_data.summary: The Kecak dance was created in the 1930s by a Balinese artist named Wayan Limbak and a German painter named Walter Spies. globaltix_product_data.description: The Kecak dance was created in the 1930s by a Balinese artist named Wayan Limbak and a German painter named Walter Spies. The Balinese Kecak dance is inspired by the Sanghyang dance. Sanghyang dance itself is a sacred Balinese dance that is performed in Hindu temples to drive away misfortune and disease. The original Kecak dance is only performed by men aged 50 years and over. Meanwhile, the name of the Kecak dance is inspired by the word “Cak… cak… cak…” which is chanted throughout the dance performance. In the past, the Balinese Kecak dance was only performed in certain areas, such as Bona Village in Gianyar Regency. Day after day, Kecak is performed in almost all areas of Bali, especially on special occasions to welcome guests. But nowadays, this dance drama is shown everywhere in Bali, especially in culture-based tourist destinations. The name “Kecak” comes from the rhythmic chanting of “cak… cak… cak…” that continues throughout the performance. Traditionally, Kecak was performed only by men aged 50 and above and was limited to certain areas such as Bona Village in Gianyar Regency. Over time, the dance became more widely performed across Bali, especially during special occasions to welcome guests. Today, Kecak dance performances can be enjoyed throughout the island, particularly at cultural tourist destinations, where they showcase Bali’s rich heritage and dramatic storytelling. Whether you’re a culture enthusiast or simply seeking an unforgettable evening, this experience is not to be missed. Your ticket includes entry to the performance, giving you access to one of Bali’s most sought-after cultural events. The Village represents a living museum to preserve the multi-ethnic Kadazandusun culture. It aims to share the knowledge, history, and cultural heritage of the multi-ethnic Kadazandusun community. The KCV offers you the opportunity to see and experience the culture and lifestyle of how the indigenous ethnic communities of the Kadazandusun used to live in the past. The village features 11 different ethnic cultural houses in one village. They are The Penampang Cultural House, The Tenom Cultural – Lansaran House, The Beaufort Cultural House, The Kota Belud Cultural House, The Kuala Penyu Cultural House, The Keningau Cultural House, The Tambunan Cultural House, The Papar Cultural House, The Ranau Cultural House, The Tuaran Cultural House and The Kudat Cultural Long House

globaltix_product_data.summary: With its flowing exterior and the whimsical chimney pots on its roof, Casa Milà - also known as - represents Gaudí at the top of his game. globaltix_product_data.description: With its flowing exterior and the whimsical chimney pots on its roof, Casa Milà - also known as - represents Gaudí at the top of his game. The ornate interior is also the handiwork of the great Catalan architect. Skip the line and get right into this modernist masterpiece.Gaudí designed Casa Milà for the wealthy businessman, Pere Milà and his wife. It's the architect's final residential building in Barcelona. For Gaudí­ enthusiasts it's a must-see, as it's the only building in the city that offers a comprehensive overview of this architectural genius. With 4,500 m2 spread over five floors, it's an immersive experience. Casa Milà features a museum, the reproduction of an early 20th century apartment (), an exhibition of Gaudí­'s work in the attic, and the grand roof terrace, with its famous chimney pots looking like surrealist chess pieces. Even though the building is named after the family who commissioned it, it's more commonly known as (The Quarry) for its resemblance to an opencast quarry. Like a miner, you're free to come inside and dig into the life and work of Barcelona's favorite son.Each ticket comes with the free audio guide, to help you experience this quirky - and architecturally sophisticated - construction.
highlights: This feature allows visitors to maximize their time exploring the site without waiting in long lines.
The package includes an audio guide that provides insightful commentary and information about Casa Milà's history, architecture, and significance.
Armed with the audio guide, visitors can embark on a self-guided tour of Casa Milà at their own pace.

globaltix_product_data.description: If you’re looking for a fun day out among nature, then this attraction is for you! Set out on a journey to Langkawi and into the Kilim Geoforest Park, a UNESCO listed heritage geo site, where the Langkawi Adventure & Xtreme Park is located. Here, experience the thrill of pedaling on a bike over a suspended cable, ziplining, paintball, and go-karting, among others, while surrounded by native flora. Bring your friends along and take turns trying out exciting activities that will surely make you want to go again. You can also choose to do activities that could help you unwind, such as going on a horseback ride or visiting the unique 3D Art Museum, where you’re free to goof around. Following the park’s trails and admiring the landscape is always an option as well. There’s something for everyone at the Langkawi Adventure & Xtreme Park!
highlights: ATV Jungle Ride: An adventurous ride through the jungle on an All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV).
Jungle Horse Riding: Experience horse riding in the lush greenery of the jungle.
Flying Fox: Soar through the air on a zip-line, also known as the Flying Fox.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit one of Malaysia's top zoos at Langkawi Wildlife Park! Witness unique attractions and marvel at the immense variety of wildlife Langkawi has to offer. Take a walk through the stunning tropical gardens and catch a glimpse of flamingos, mouse-deer, and auricle foxes. Drop by the aviary and be blown away by the incredibly colorful bird species. Don't miss the chance to see emus, pelicans, koi, deer, crocodiles, and otters.
highlights: The park is the first fully-covered wildlife park in Asia.
It offers a unique experience where visitors can have close interactions with animals.
The park is home to more than 150 different animal species.
The park offers a unique mix of fun and excitement for visitors of all ages.
The park is divided into 4 areas (A, B, C, and D), with most of the interaction with the animals happening in areas B and C.

globaltix_product_data.summary: You’ve seen it in movies, cartoons and countless (arguably) cheesy pictures. globaltix_product_data.description: You’ve seen it in movies, cartoons and countless (arguably) cheesy pictures. But once you come out of Pisa’s bustling streets and finally have a clear view of the Leaning Tower, you’ll understand why it’s such an icon. This famous building is actually the bell tower for the nearby cathedral. To get the most out of your visit to the Piazza dei Miracoli, make sure to visit both. And this ticket gets you skip-the-line access to the pair!When you enter Pisa’s , your eyes are drawn to the unmistakable tower - but that’s just the beginning. It's no surprise that this place is called Square of Miracles. It’s filled with enough architectural wonder that UNESCO declared it a World Heritage Site in 1987. Plus, so much went wrong during the history of the Leaning Tower, from a famously poor foundation to the Nazis using it as a lookout, that its continued existence is nothing short of miraculous. Once you finish gaping at the stunning marble exterior of the (and taking a few “Look at me, I’m holding a tower” pictures), use our skip-the-line tickets to climb inside the insanely tilted . From its top you'll get fabulous views and maybe even hear its bells ringing. There are seven of them in all, one for each musical note.Right after that you can pop into the equally gorgeous (but only-slightly-tilted) Cathedral of St. Mary of the Assumption and take your sweet time enjoying treasures like the mosaic of Christ in Majesty, the frescoed dome, and the impressive white marble panels which narrate stories from the New Testament. All of those historical features survived a 1595 fire powerful enough to melt the original bronze doors.If you were already leaning towards visiting those two miracles, remember that the tower has closed to the public many times in the past so its structure could be strengthened. Right now you can see it and climb it in all its glory. Seize the day.In 1944, American Sergeant Leon Weckstein was ordered to check if the Nazis were using the Tower of Pisa as an observation post. They were, but Weckstein was so mesmerized by the splendor of the tower that he wasn't able to bring himself to order the strikes. Thanks in part to his sensitivity to beauty, we still have the tower today.
highlights: See, climb up, and photograph the heck out of one of the most recognizable buildings in the world: the Leaning Tower of Pisa
Explore the many treasures inside the Pisa Cathedral, including a wooden pulpit carved in 1310 and a gilded mosaic
Take a guided walk around Piazza dei Miracoli and its monuments, and get heaps of fun facts from an expert local guide
inclusions: Entry to the Tower of Pisa

The towering towers and buildings are all made of LEGO® blocks, and look just like the real thing! Looking at the diorama, you might get the strange sensation of being as big as a giant. When the sun goes down, the city lights up, transforming into a beautiful night view. Discover the secret of how soft plastic is shaped into LEGO® bricks! globaltix_product_data.description: Shanghai Legoland Resort is a comprehensive tourist destination designed for families with children aged 2-12. The park consists of a theme park consisting of eight theme areas and a supporting theme resort hotel. Here, you will find classic Legoland rides and new theme areas around the world, a play experience full of traditional Chinese culture and Shanghai elements, and more than 75 interactive rides, exciting performances and entertainment attractions are waiting for you!

You will find classic Legoland rides and new theme areas around the world, a play experience full of traditional Chinese culture and Shanghai elements, and more

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Age requirements Minors under 16 years old (not included) must be accompanied by visitors aged 16 years old (inclusive) or above to enter the park, and must bring your original valid ID card. Dress code 1. Please do not wear inappropriate or revealing clothing. Do not wear clothing that contains insulting language, offensive religious symbols, cult symbols, or any indecent clothing. In addition, avoid wearing long skirts or other clothing that may affect the experience of other visitors. 2. Do not wear clothing with commercial purposes or a promotional nature. 3. Do not wear special effects makeup or masks, veils, or other items that cover the whole face or most of the face, except for masks/masks worn for medical or health reasons, and other situations with written permission from the park. 4. Visitors must keep their clothes neat in the park. Do not wear clothing that may be mistaken by visitors as Shanghai Legoland staff. If it is determined that the dress is inappropriate, indecent, or affects the experience of other visitors, we have the right to refuse entry to the park or ask them to leave the park. No pets allowed Please do not bring any animals other than guide dogs. Guide dogs must be on a leash and supervised by their owners at all times. Please understand that guide dogs may not be allowed on some rides. Other restrictions The following items are not allowed to be brought into the park (including but not limited to): flammable and explosive items; weapons; food that needs to be heated or reheated; food with a pungent odor; alcoholic beverages; animals; items prohibited by relevant laws; and other dangerous or destructive items.

globaltix_product_data.description: Legong Dance, also known as Legong Kraton, is one of Bali’s most revered classical court dances, once performed exclusively within royal palaces. Originating in the 19th century, it is renowned for its intricate choreography, expressive gestures, and fast-paced movements executed by young female dancers adorned in elaborate gold costumes. Accompanied by a powerful gamelan orchestra, the dance narrates an ancient royal tale of love, conflict, and fate, blending elegance, precision, and storytelling into a mesmerizing cultural performance now enjoyed at cultural stages across Bali.
highlights: Experience the essence of Bali's cultural heritage through the visually stunning Legong Dance
Delve into Bali's royal history as you witness the Legong Kraton, originally performed exclusively within palace walls for the royal family
atch in awe as young female performers demonstrate incredible agility and grace, executing the demanding poses and quick movements of the Legong Dance

globaltix_product_data.description: The Leopold Museum houses one of the most important collections of early 20th-century Austrian art. Avid art collectors Rudolf and Elisabeth Leopold collected more than 5,000 exhibits over five decades. Housed in Vienna's popular MuseumsQuartier, the Leopold's dense collection features artists such as Egon Schiele, Gustav Klimt, Oskar Kokoschka and Richard Gerstl. The collection was consolidated in 1994, and in 2001 the museum opened its doors to the public.When young medical student Rudolf Leopold purchased his first work of art in his mid-twenties, nobody could have predicted that it would become an obsession. Forty years later Rudolf Leopold consolidated more than 5,000 artworks and objects into a private foundation valued at 575 million Euros. The collection, in its permanent home in a museum purpose-built by the Austrian state, is the largest and most-visited museum in Vienna's MuseumsQuartier.The main focus of the collection is Austrian art of the first half of the 20th century, and includes the world's largest collection of works by the influential Austrian Expressionist Egon Schiele. The focus is his radical and expressive works, created between 1910 and 1915. There's also an impressive set of works by world-renowned artist Gustav Klimt - co-founder of the Vienna Secession in 1897. The permanent exhibition allows visitors to experience the diversity of an era marked by the idea of the , (a 'total work of art' that permeates all aspects of life). The works on display here include Expressionist paintings, pieces from the Vienna Secession, and masterpieces of the Wiener Werkstätte - the Viennese arts and crafts movement.
highlights: The world's largest collection of works by Austrian Expressionist Egon Schiele
Highlights include works by Gustav Klimt (Death and Life) and Oskar Kokoschka (Tre Croci)
Huge windows on the cuboid building offer panoramic views of the city – and fill the exhibitions with light, to illuminate your art-going experience

globaltix_product_data.description: With its unrivaled art collection and harrowing history, Lobkowicz Palace gives you the best of Prague all under one beautifully baroque roof. Book your ticket to Prague’s top-ranked museum and get a free audio guide narrated by the Lobkowicz family themselves!As Prague Castle’s only private wing, Lobkowicz Palace offers an exclusive look into true Czech opulence and the fascinating historical drama that comes with it.Get the inside scoop on the amazing story of this 16th-century landmark, which includes true tales of priests thrown out of windows, devastating Nazi occupation, and a communist takeover — all told by the royal family members themselves. We won’t ruin the ending, but don’t worry, it’s a happy one.Ranked Prague’s number one museum by TripAdvisor, Lobkowicz Palace is home to world-famous paintings you’ll definitely recognize. You’ll also get to peek at original classical manuscripts such as Mozart’s hand-annotated score of and Beethoven’s groundbreaking .The Panorama audio tour offers a guided walk through breathtaking 180° view of the city, including some of Prague’s most famous landmarks; Prague Castle, St. Vitus Cathedral, Old Town Square, and Charles Bridge.

See world-famous masterpieces by Canaletto, Brueghel the Elder, Cranach, and Velázquez, plus original, hand-annotated manuscripts by Beethoven and Mozart
On the café terrace you can enjoy a king’s view of Prague over a steaming cup of hot chocolate
inclusions: Visit to the terrace with views over Prague

globaltix_product_data.summary: London Zoo is perhaps the most famous zoo in the whole world. globaltix_product_data.description: London Zoo is perhaps the most famous zoo in the whole world. Built by Victorian gentlemen with names like Sir Stamford Raffles and Decimus Burton, it’s been an important part of London life for almost 200 years. Today you’ll be able to take in over 750 species of animals while walking through its historic buildings and grounds.The London Zoo has undergone a transformation in the past few years. From its Victorian-era 'animal park' origins, it's now a conservation-minded institution that puts you right in the heart of untamed action.Charismatic lowland gorillas, prehistoric komodo dragons and Galapagos turtles, mighty lions and tigers... all the big-ticket creatures are on display here. But that's not all, and more will round out your day with plenty of animal sightings. And for the bug lovers, the zoo features a filled with the large and loveable winged creatures. It even has an exhibit (which strives to persuade you that arachnids are adorable). If the thought of spending time with spiders sounds ridiculous, visit the two Pygmy Hippos. agrees that Thug and Nicky are delightful.This summer the London Zoo has some very special guests - the likes of the gentle brachiosaurus and the terrifying T-Rex. Travel back 65 million years via a time machine and get a guided tour through the Mesozoic era. See dinosaur nests, encounter the armour-plated Edmontonia and learn what ZSL’s conservationists are doing to stop more creatures from becoming extinct.
highlights: With talks and feeding sessions throughout the day, there's plenty of opportunities to really get to know the inhabitants here

Visit the Gorilla Kingdom and see a family of silverback gorillas at close quarters. They have their own island, gym, and African rainforest (seriously!)

The park is designed to cater to visitors of all ages, ensuring fun and adventure for families, thrill-seekers, and children alike. In addition to the adrenaline-pumping rides, Lotte World Adventure Busan boasts various live performances, parades, and seasonal events, making it a perfect year-round destination. The park also features a variety of dining options, souvenir shops, and themed areas, offering an unforgettable experience for everyone. Located within a larger entertainment complex, Lotte World Adventure Busan is an ideal spot to create lasting memories while enjoying a wide array of attractions and entertainment in one of South Korea's most dynamic cities.

Visitors can enjoy both indoor and outdoor zones, with highlights including the iconic *Atlantis Adventure*, the spinning *Gyro Drop*, and the *Safari Adventure* that lets guests get up close with various animals. The park is designed to cater to visitors of all ages, ensuring fun and adventure for families, thrill-seekers, and children alike. In addition to the adrenaline-pumping rides, Lotte World Adventure Busan boasts various live performances, parades, and seasonal events, making it a perfect year-round destination. The park also features a variety of dining options, souvenir shops, and themed areas, offering an unforgettable experience for everyone. Located within a larger entertainment complex, Lotte World Adventure Busan is an ideal spot to create lasting memories while enjoying a wide array of attractions and entertainment in one of South Korea's most dynamic cities.

globaltix_product_data.description: Inspired by the endless wonders of the deep blue ocean and the unique cultural heritage of Vietnam, the aquarium is designed to reflect traditional folklore, based on the legend of Cá Ông - the guardian god of fishermen on their sea voyages. Spanning a vast area of 9,094 square meters with 67 tanks, this underwater kingdom is home to over 31,000 marine species, from adorable jellyfish to powerful sharks. Notably, you will have the chance to meet the first-ever family of California sea lions born in Vietnam! A wide range of educational and recreational activities are available, offering visitors, especially children, fascinating and insightful experiences about the ocean world. Explore the marine ecosystem with Cá Ông through AR technology, where you'll dive deep into the enchanting ocean world and uncover hidden secrets of marine creatures.

globaltix_product_data.description: This attraction is a skyscraper standing in Seoul, South Korea, attracting countless tourists with its magnificent appearance and rich business formats. This 555-meter-high, 123-story building not only provides a variety of functions such as office, shopping, and entertainment, but also has an amazing sightseeing experience. Starting from the 117th floor, the observatory overlooks the panoramic view of Seoul, including famous landmarks such as the Han River. The scenery is particularly charming at dusk and night. The glass-paneled observatory on the 118th floor allows visitors to experience the shock of the sky up close. In addition, the restaurant and cafe on the top floor also provide a unique dining experience. Inside the building, Lotte World Shopping City and duty-free shops provide a wealth of shopping options to meet the shopping needs of tourists. Whether it is a family trip or a gathering of friends, Lotte World Tower is a good place to explore.
highlights: Cultural and Entertainment Hub: Lotte World Tower also includes a concert hall and art gallery, making it a center for cultural events and entertainment
Luxury and Modernity: The tower features a mix of luxury hotels, offices, retail spaces, and residential areas, making it a symbol of modern architecture
Tallest Building in Korea: Standing at 555 meters, Lotte World Tower is the tallest building in South Korea and the fifth tallest in the world
Dining with a View: Enjoy fine dining experiences at the tower’s upscale restaurants, offering delicious cuisine with a view of the city skyline.

globaltix_product_data.description: Madame Tussauds Hong Kong is an extraordinary wax museum that brings the world of fame and celebrity to life. Located in the vibrant city of Hong Kong, this iconic attraction invites visitors to immerse themselves in a captivating world of lifelike wax figures. As you enter Madame Tussauds, you'll be greeted by a dazzling array of meticulously crafted wax replicas of renowned celebrities from various fields such as film, music, sports, history, and politics. From Hollywood A-listers and global music sensations to sporting legends and historical icons, the museum features an impressive collection of over 100 lifelike figures. Take the opportunity to stand alongside your favorite stars, strike a pose for the perfect photo, and even interact with some of the figures through immersive and interactive exhibits. Experience the thrill of meeting your favorite celebrities up close, without missing a beat or losing your breath. Madame Tussauds Hong Kong offers more than just a chance to snap selfies with wax figures. The museum provides a rich and engaging experience, with themed zones and immersive sets that transport you to different worlds. Walk the red carpet at the "World Premiere" zone, explore the "K-Wave" zone dedicated to Korean pop culture, or step into the glitz and glamour of the "World Leaders" zone. Only the greats get a spot at Madame Tussauds Hong Kong. In their pursuit to find the next Filipino talent to immortalise, it’s no surprise that they finally landed on one of the brightest acts of her time, Asia’s renowned actress Kathryn Bernardo. A multi-awarded actress, Kathryn’s stellar career spans two decades and counting. Known as the Phenomenal Box-Office Queen of Philippine Cinema, she began acting at the age of seven and quickly established herself as a leading lady with a string of hit teleseryes and films, including Got to Believe, Pangako Sa 'Yo, The Hows of Us, and Hello, Love, Goodbye, which was coincidentally set in Hong Kong. The latter’s sequel, Hello, Love, Again, made history as the first Filipino film to earn over one billion pesos at the worldwide box office, becoming the highest-grossing Filipino film of all time. Kathryn’s remarkable success and global fan base, reaching fans in Vietnam, Thailand, South Korea, and beyond, have made her a sought after endorser for top brands. In 2020, Forbes Asia recognised her as one of the most influential celebrities on social media in the Asia-Pacific region, cementing her status as a media favourite and acting powerhouse in the entertainment industry. This year, Kathryn is adding another milestone to her illustrious career with her inclusion at Madame Tussauds Hong Kong. “It’s a dream come true to have my own wax figure, and I’m grateful to the Madame Tussauds Hong Kong team for their trust in me,” said Kathryn, who had her measurements taken during her sitting session last August. “I’m excited for my fans worldwide to visit and interact with my twin, especially as Hong Kong especially since it’s such a meaningful milestone for me.” Kathryn is the fourth Filipino personality to be immortalised by Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, following Pia Wurtzbach, Manny Pacquiao, and Anne Curtis. “We value our Filipino market and aim to provide them with an unforgettable experience at Madame Tussauds Hong Kong,” said Wade Chang, General Manager of Merlin Entertainments Hong Kong. “Kathryn is an inspiring artist who has worked tirelessly to achieve her success. At Madame Tussauds, we honour excellence with a global impact, making Kathryn the perfect choice for our next Filipino wax figure.” Kathryn’s likeness will be displayed alongside Hollywood icons like Rihanna, Timothée Chalamet, and Chris Hemsworth. The attraction’s skilled sculptors are crafting the actress’s wax figure, and fans can expect it to be unveiled in 2026.

Step into immersive sets and interactive exhibits that bring the world of fame and glamour to life.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Madame Tussauds Singapore is an interactive wax museum and immersive attraction located at Imbiah Lookout. It combines lifelike celebrity figures, engaging storytelling, and themed experiences into one exciting journey. Guests can meet global icons, explore Singapore’s rich heritage, and enjoy uniqu...
globaltix_product_data.description: Madame Tussauds Singapore is an interactive wax museum and immersive attraction located at Imbiah Lookout. It combines lifelike celebrity figures, engaging storytelling, and themed experiences into one exciting journey. Guests can meet global icons, explore Singapore’s rich heritage, and enjoy unique attractions like the Marvel 4D Experience and Ultimate Film Star Experience, making it a must-visit for visitors of all ages. Guests are recommended to spend 2–3 hours exploring the attraction. The experience is largely self-paced, allowing visitors to move through each zone freely, while selected highlights such as the Marvel 4D show may run on scheduled timings. The total duration may vary depending on crowd levels and time spent at each interactive exhibit. Upon arrival, guests can enter via QR code e-ticket or redeem vouchers at the counter. The journey typically begins with Images of Singapore LIVE, where visitors are immersed in the nation’s history through interactive, actor-led storytelling. Guests then proceed through the wax galleries, posing with incredibly realistic figures of celebrities such as Johnny Depp, Nicole Kidman, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Muhammad Ali. The experience continues at the Marvel 4D Experience, where guests can interact with superheroes, try on Iron Man’s armor, and take photos with Spider-Man before enjoying a dynamic 4D film. The visit concludes with the Ultimate Film Star Experience, where guests step into cinematic sets and enjoy a behind-the-scenes journey into the life of a movie star, creating a fun and memorable finale.
highlights: Celebrity Encounters: Meet lifelike wax figures of global icons like Johnny Depp, Nicole Kidman & Cristiano Ronaldo for fun photo moments
Immersive Experiences: Explore Images of Singapore LIVE, Marvel 4D Experience & Ultimate Film Star Experience in one attraction
Iconic Attraction: Visit the world-famous Madame Tussauds Singapore at Sentosa’s Imbiah Lookout
All-in-One Access: Enjoy entry to wax galleries, interactive zones, superhero 4D show & themed storytelling experiences
Perfect for Everyone: Ideal for families, friends, couples & pop culture fans seeking fun, interactive entertainment
inclusions: (Part of standard admission) Ultimate Film Star Experience - Audition, act and dance alongside Indian movie stars
(Part of standard admission) Spirit of Singapore Boat Ride: Enjoy the sights and scenes of Singapore in miniature forms.
(Part of standard admission) Madame Tussauds: Come up close and personal with various world leaders in the field of sports, music and film.
(Part of standard admission) Images of Singapore: Uncovers the nation’s extraordinary history from a fishing village to 21st century powerhouse.

Additional Information All persons must practice safe distancing of a minimum of 1 meter within the attraction. Upon arrival, guests are required to fill in their contact details via SafeEntry before entering Madame Tussauds Singapore. Baby prams/strollers are not allowed inside and must be left at the designated drop-off point. Important Notes Madame Tussauds Singapore does not provide refunds or replacements if any featured entitlement is unavailable due to scheduled maintenance or unforeseen circumstances. Management is not responsible for any loss or damage to prams/strollers or valuables left at the drop-off point. This activity is not recommended for guests with medical conditions (e.g., high blood pressure, epilepsy), pregnant women, or seniors. Travel up the path pass Subway and turn right to reach the red carpets of Madame Tussauds Singapore By Cable Car: From Harbourfront MRT station, make your way to the Cable Car Station at Harbourfront Tower 2. globaltix_product_data.description: Craving a brush with fame? Head to Madame Tussauds Sydney! This interactive wax museum in Darling Harbour lets you meet over 100 lifelike figures of Aussie icons and global stars. Walk through eleven themed zones, from rocking out with music legends to mingling with A-listers at a virtual Sydney party. History buffs can meet national heroes, while superhero fans can assemble with the Justice League. Beyond selfies, Madame Tussauds Sydney offers interactive fun. Test your skills against Aussie athletes or become a newscaster for the night. It's a must-visit for pop culture enthusiasts and history lovers alike!
highlights: Over 100 incredibly lifelike wax figures await, including Aussie icons and global celebrities.
Explore eleven unique zones like the Music zone to rock out with legends, or the thrilling Justice League HQ to assemble with superheroes.
Over 100 lifelike wax figures of Australian and international celebrities.
Eleven themed zones for unique experiences
Interactive experiences: Test your athletic skills or become a newscaster for the night.

globaltix_product_data.description: Sabah, situated within the Borneo island is renown with the intrinsic diversify cultures that one should not miss when visiting the Land below the Wind. In Mari Mari cultural village, you will have the chance to visit 5 major tribes in Sabah namely the Murut, Bajau, Lundayeh, Kadazan Dusun & Rungus. In each different tribe houses, you will be able to understand & experience different ethnic groups culture, tradition, ritual & background by participating in these hands-on tribe activities such as the conventional method on fire-starting, blow-pipe shooting, bamboo dance & many more! Traditional food/snacks will also be served while having fun throughout the activities.
highlights: Discover the art of fire-starting using conventional methods
Savor traditional food and snacks from each tribe, providing a mouthwatering journey through Sabah's rich culinary heritage.
Mari Mari Cultural Village serves as a living museum dedicated to preserving the precious cultural heritage of Sabah's indigenous peoples.
Step into the lives of five major Sabah tribes – the Murut, Bajau, Lundayeh, Kadazan Dusun, and Rungus.

globaltix_product_data.description: The two Medici Chapels, in the Basilica of San Lorenzo, are an incredibly lavish mausoleum and a key site on the Florence Renaissance trail. After all, they not only contain three beautiful Michelangelo sculptures, they're also the final resting place for 49 members of the powerful Medici clan. Skip the lines and get into this spectacular Renaissance church.The Medici Chapels () are two unmissable structures at the Basilica of San Lorenzo in Florence, dating back to the 16th and 17th century. Thanks to Michelangelo's magic hands this mausoleum for the Medici family members (patrons of the Renaissance and Grand Dukes of Tuscany) has become a pilgrimage spot for art lovers. Once inside, you'll be welcomed by a statue of Anna Maria Luisa de Medici, the last member of the family. She is the one who bequeathed the entire Medici family collection of art to Florence, including Michelangelo's sculptures. Her only condition was that it would always be available for the public to enjoy. Something we're all grateful for to this day. Highlights here include Michelangelo's , the great artist's first efforts at architecture. Its innovative approach suggests later bold moves he would make when working on St. Peter's Basilica in Rome.The three sculpture groups on the tombs are: on the sarcophagus of Lorenzo il Magnifico; the on the sarcophagus of Lorenzo's son Giuliano; and the unfinished altarpiece of .

Behold three remarkable sculptures by Michelangelo, showcasing his genius and mastery of marble: Day and Night, Dawn and Dusk, and Madonna and Child
Admire the grandeur of the New Sacristy, designed by Michelangelo as a mausoleum for the Medici family.
Immerse yourself in the Renaissance splendor of the Medici Chapels, a harmonious blend of art and architecture.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Kecak dance was created in the 1930s by a Balinese artist named Wayan Limbak and a German painter named Walter Spies. The Balinese Kecak dance is inspired by the Sanghyang dance. Sanghyang dance itself is a sacred Balinese dance that is performed in Hindu temples to drive away misfortune and dis...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Kecak dance was created in the 1930s by a Balinese artist named Wayan Limbak and a German painter named Walter Spies. The Balinese Kecak dance is inspired by the Sanghyang dance. Sanghyang dance itself is a sacred Balinese dance that is performed in Hindu temples to drive away misfortune and disease. The original Kecak dance is only performed by men aged 50 years and over. Meanwhile, the name of the Kecak dance is inspired by the word “Cak… cak… cak…” which is chanted throughout the dance performance. In the past, the Balinese Kecak dance was only performed in certain areas, such as Bona Village in Gianyar Regency. Day after day, Kecak is performed in almost all areas of Bali, especially on special occasions to welcome guests. But nowadays, this dance drama is shown everywhere in Bali, especially in culture-based tourist destinations. globaltix_product_data.summary: The Modern Contemporary Museum Amsterdam (Moco) is located inside Villa Alsberg, a townhouse dating back to 1904, in the heart of Amsterdam's Museumplein. globaltix_product_data.description: The Modern Contemporary Museum Amsterdam (Moco) is located inside Villa Alsberg, a townhouse dating back to 1904, in the heart of Amsterdam's Museumplein. Explore over 50 original Banksys alongside works by artworld trailblazers like Kusama, Roy Lichtenstein, Dali, and more! The museum also features ever-revolving exhibitions. Banksy: Laugh Now marks the first institutionalized exhibition of Banksy's work, offering a rare glimpse into his artwork, including Beanfield, unseen since 2009. Famous pieces like the Laugh Now series, Barcode, Girl with Balloon, and Love Is In The Air (Flower Thrower) are showcased alongside Banksy's confrontational indoor works, creating a striking contrast with the elegant townhouse setting. Some pieces were rescued from demolished buildings, highlighting their value. On the lower ground floor, explore immersive exhibition spaces featuring influential artists like Keith Haring, KAWS, and more. Secure your Moco Museum Amsterdam tickets for entry into the city's coolest art museum! Audio guide: Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish
highlights: Visit the first Banksy museum exhibition and see classics like Love Is In The Air, Barcode, Girl with Balloon, and the rarely seen Beanfield

globaltix_product_data.description: It looks straight out of a fantasy film - as if dragons might swoop down as you enter. But you haven't stepped into a parallel universe - you've just discovered the Abbaye du Mont Saint-Michel. This astounding World Heritage Site lies just off the rocky coast of Normandy. It's a medieval must-see! Explore 20 rooms, stunning gardens, and get panoramic views of the sea and sky.Le Mont Saint-Michel is a small island commune in Normandy, and the Abbaye du Mont Saint-Michel is most definitely its crowning glory, looming over it all like a big stone soldier as the waves crash on its rocky shores. The worship of Archangel Michel first occurred in this spot in 708 AD, making it 'the' place for a medieval pilgrimage.In the 10th century the Benedictine monks realized its importance and promptly set about building a proper abbey here. In 1874 the abbey was listed as a historic monument; this was after the monks said their goodbyes in 1790. It draws as many crowds today as it did hundreds of years ago - thanks to its airy interior and majestic position.With over 20 rooms and spires and towers looming over the town below, there's plenty to explore. You can also join a guided group for free - just ask when you arrive and you'll be placed in a group for a tour. As you walk around the abbey, take the chance to watch the tide roll in and out (it has Europe's highest tidal variations, swelling and dropping as much as 15 meters in as little as six hours). Reaching the summit of the abbey will reward you with unbelievable panoramas; you'll feel like the king of a French castle. Or the abbot of a French abbey.

globaltix_product_data.description: Located in the heart of Đà Nẵng city, the Da Nang Museum of Cham Sculpture is the world’s largest museum dedicated to the ancient Champa civilization. Established in 1919, this century-old museum showcases over 400 artifacts dating from the 5th to 15th centuries — including 12 National Treasures. Visitors can explore exquisite stone carvings, terracotta sculptures, and metal artworks depicting Hindu and Buddhist deities, sacred animals, and mythical motifs that reflect the cultural and artistic sophistication of the Champa Kingdom. The museum’s distinctive architecture, inspired by Champa temples, adds to its charm and historical significance. Recognized as a first-class museum in Vietnam and a City-level Historical Monument, this cultural landmark offers an unforgettable journey through one of Southeast Asia’s most fascinating ancient civilizations.
highlights: Explore 12 geographical galleries and 2 thematic sections featuring artifacts from Central and Central Highlands Vietnam.
Admire the largest and most complete collection of Champa sculptures in the world.
Learn about the Champa civilization’s art, religion, and culture through centuries-old masterpieces.
Discover 12 National Treasures, including the Trà Kiệu Pedestal and the Statue of Shiva Mỹ Sơn C1.
Appreciate the unique architectural design blending French colonial and Cham temple styles.

globaltix_product_data.description: In a monumental (and gorgeous!) building on the Herengracht, lies Amsterdam's Canal Museum. A whirlwind tour will take you back to the time when Amsterdam flourished as the main city of the Dutch Golden Age.Upon entering, grab an audio guide, then take a seat. Minutes later the lights dim and you're back in the year 1600, Amsterdam's heyday. Here you'll get all the context you need to understand Amsterdam's famous (and UNESCO-protected) canals. And throughout your experience at the Museum of the Canals (), you'll develop a deeper appreciation for this city and the waterways that define it.This museum uses a broad set of tools - holograms, paintings, models, audio guides, and architecture (among others) to bring the significance and experience of Amsterdam's famous waterways to life. Their role in the prosperous commerce of this mercantile culture are highlighted, as well as the remarkable engineering achievement that they represent.But it's not just the historical experience that is showcased here - Amsterdam's canals are a big part of daily life and civic celebrations, and that is also part of the museum here. The world famous Amsterdam Gay Pride Parade, the Beatles on their famous boatride through the canals during the height of 'Beatlemania', and the skating on the canals that takes place during the (now rare) cold winters. There's even an excerpt from the cult-classic B-movie, . As the itself says, "This museum is for everyone who loves, or is just about to fall in love with the city of Amsterdam". So then, it's for everyone.
highlights: Discover the story of the Amsterdam canals in a monumental house on the historic Herengracht
Marvel at the meticulous detail and craftsmanship of the stunning 17th-century doll's houses
Travel back in time to the Dutch Golden Age with an engaging audio guide, vivid holograms and special imagery

globaltix_product_data.description: The Musée Picasso in Paris has an incredible collection of over five thousand works of art. Dedicated to one of the most well-known artists of the 20th century, this spectacular 17th-century hôtel particulier is filled to the brim with iconic modern masterpieces by Pablo Picasso - as well as works that he collected. This ticket gives you priority entrance to the legacy of an artistic genius. Pop into Picasso. Pablo Picasso is one of the most iconic figures in 20th-century art. The Spanish painter, sculptor and graphic artist is known for his inventive techniques and versatile avant-garde style. Picasso used materials in ways that had never been used before, inspiring artists who came after to follow in his brushstrokes. His singular style inspired movements such as Futurism and Dadaism, and this museum showcases the range and depth of his work. It also includes unseen photographs of the artist himself, as well as works from Picasso's private collection - including pieces by Cézanne, Degas, and Matisse. This museum is housed in the Hôtel Salé - a building that has been described as one of the most extravagant grand homes of the 17th century. It was renovated and reopened in October 2014 with double the exhibition space and new reception areas. In the same way that Picasso reveled in mixing medias and creating new styles from old ways of working, this stately mansion is a perfect setting to experience some of the world's most groundbreaking modern painting and sculpture. Getting There: Metro: Line 1, Saint-Paul; Line 8, Saint-Sébastien-Froissart; Line 8, Chemin Vert Bus: Line 20, 29, 65, 75, 69 or 96

Take a journey through Picasso’s creative process and experimental styles via the comprehensive exhibitions and archives
Enjoy a collection of over 5,000 works by Picasso and other works from his personal collection - including pieces by Cézanne, Degas, and Matisse

globaltix_product_data.summary: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? globaltix_product_data.description: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? Grab a ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, and discover a treasure trove of ancient wonders that would make Pandora's Box jealous! See glorious statues and frescoes from antiquity depicting mythical heroes and legends, marvel at mosaics, bronze and glasswork, and see ceramics and engraved copper from Pompeii, classical Greece, Egypt, Rome, and more.With this ticket, you'll also receive a free code to use in the Pemcards app. So, if you see something you love inside the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, snap a selfie with it and you can create a postcard that will be sent to your friends and family so they enjoy a snippet of your holiday as more than just a picture sent via text.Visit the museum's macabre centerpiece, the iconic Toro Farnese (Farnese Bull). It's the oldest single sculpture ever recovered from antiquity, depicting the myth of Dirce, who was tied to the horns of a bull by her brothers as a cruel form of punishment.Strike a pose with the muscle-bound Farnese Hercules flexing his demi-god bod, and spare a thought for poor old Atlas holding the weight of the world on his shoulders.The Farnese Atlas is the oldest extant statue of the great titan, and the oldest known representation of the celestial sphere in existence, so it's a unique piece of human history you will not want to miss.Peruse a magnificent collection of carbonized artifacts from Pompeii, relics and epigraphs from ancient Egypt, Rome, and lot more.

Marvel at the colossal and historical Toro Farnese (the Farnese Bull), Farnese Atlas, and Hercules statues

Venue Address: 900 Exposition Boulevard
Enter with your ticket at any of the two museum entrances
Go directly to the staff member at the bridge or skip the line through the e-ticket entry at the top of the steps.
Smoking is prohibited on premises
NHM is closed the 1st Tuesday of every month
**How to get there?**
All NHM visitors can now park in the NHM Car Park, located on Bill Robertson Lane, just south of Exposition Boulevard
There is a limited number of ADA spots available for guests with visible ADA placards
The museum now has 40 new charging stations for electric vehicles
Take the Expo Line to visit
The closest stations to NHM are the Expo/USC and Expo/Vermont stations
Trains run daily from 5 am to 12:30 am
USC football games: The Coliseum at Exposition Park hosts USC football games throughout the Fall and Winter season
Plan extra travel time on game days as the area will be busy
Check ongoing and upcoming exhibitions [here](https://nhm.org/experience-nhm/exhibitions-natural-history-museum)

globaltix_product_data.description: ***Very important***: The "Starting Time" you choose, is the time you pick up your tickets from our office. The tour begins in Neuschwanstein two hours later.*** Pick up your tickets in good time -ONLY- from our office inside Füssen Train Station. We will provide you with maps and tips as well as your original tickets. You can then make your way to Neuschwanstein Castle by car, bike or local bus. Skip the line and explore a fairytale world with your pre-booked tickets. Make the most of your visit without the hassle of long queues. Why Our Neuschwanstein Ticket Prices Are Higher We understand that some of our customers are price-conscious and may notice that our Neuschwanstein Castle ticket prices are higher than booking directly online. Here's why: ️ Very Limited Supply: Neuschwanstein tickets sell out fast. We work hard to secure a small number of tickets in advance for our customers, especially during high season. Reservation Fees: We pay extra fees to reserve tickets ahead of time, ensuring you get a spot even when they’re sold out elsewhere. Third-Party Charges: We incur additional surcharges from platforms like Get Your Guide, which help us offer you a smooth booking experience. Business Costs: Like any service, we also need to cover our operating costs and earn a fair margin to keep running. If you're very price-sensitive and don’t mind some risk, you can try booking directly through the official site. But if you value peace of mind and guaranteed entry, our tickets might be the right choice for you. Thanks for understanding!
highlights: Enjoy an unforgettable experience at one of Germany's most iconic landmarks
Admire the stunning architecture and breathtaking views of the Bavarian Alps
Explore the fairytale world of Neuschwanstein Castle with a skip-the-line ticket
Bypass the long lines and immerse yourself in the castle's rich splendor
Discover the history of the castle, which was commissioned by King Ludwig II

options.description: Meeting point: Be at International Ticket and Travel Center, Bahnhofstrasse 12, 87629 Füssen in Füssen Train Station on time! Your Get your Guide Voucher will not allow access to Neuschwanstein Castle. You must pick up your original ticket from our office in Füssen Train Station to enter the castle. If your ticket confirmation is for 9:30 - this is your pick up time not your tour time. It takes at least 90 minutes to get to the castle after collecting your tickets, parking your car, getting the shuttle bus or horse and carriage (or walking!) up the mountain to the castle. If you are coming by train, our office is at the end of the track in Füssen. If you are arriving by car, you can park beside our office to collect the tickets. for more information click HERE What to bring: Comfortable shoes Water

globaltix_product_data.name: New Taipei City Yingge Ceramics Museum
globaltix_product_data.summary: The New Taipei City Yingge Ceramics Museum, officially opening on November 26, 2000, is Taiwan's first professional museum dedicated to ceramics. Dedicated to the investigation, collection, preservation, and conservation of Taiwanese ceramic culture, the museum engages in research, archiving, exhibi...
globaltix_product_data.description: The New Taipei City Yingge Ceramics Museum, officially opening on November 26, 2000, is Taiwan's first professional museum dedicated to ceramics. Dedicated to the investigation, collection, preservation, and conservation of Taiwanese ceramic culture, the museum engages in research, archiving, exhibition, and educational outreach. It actively promotes international exchange and collaboration, hosting international artist residencies, joining the International Council of Museums, and establishing sister museum partnerships with museums in Germany and Spain. The museum also secured the right to host the 2018 International Ceramics Society World Congress, showcasing the beauty of Taiwanese ceramics internationally and showcasing the vibrant and vibrant beauty of Taiwanese ceramics. The Ceramics Museum's architectural form features a gray exterior constructed of exposed concrete and steel. Its high ceilings, sober colors, and extensive glass curtain walls allow natural light to filter in. The continuous, layered flow of sunlight created by the exposed concrete, washed stone walls, gray stone, and tan wood exterior creates a rich, layered effect. The richness of the exhibits is reflected in the rich, textured interior space. Upon ascending the stone steps at the Ceramics Museum's entrance, one is greeted by the sound and visual effects of the large water wall and pool, evoking a sense of calm and a shifting of emotions. 1. First Floor: This floor houses a ceramics collection (cultural merchandise store), a consultation and service area, a ceramics stage, permanent exhibitions, and a special exhibition room. In addition to permanent and special exhibitions, various performances and experiential activities are also held from time to time. 2. Second Floor: The museum's permanent exhibition focuses on the development of Taiwanese ceramics, divided into five major themes: "Transformation from Clay," "Reflections on Our Origins," "Kaizi Town," "Journey Through Time," and "Future Prophecy." Using a variety of exhibits, graphics, videos, and interactive technology, the museum creates a variety of display scenarios, guiding visitors into Taiwan's diverse and rich ceramic culture. 3. Third Floor: Located on this floor is the Special Exhibition Room, where the museum curates several special exhibitions each year, allowing the public to experience the beauty of ceramics. 4. Basement 1 & 2: The basement level houses the Information Center, International Lecture Hall, Children's Experience Room, Ceramics Gallery, and a restaurant. The basement level 2 houses the Ceramics Workshop. Here, visitors can enjoy small themed exhibitions by ceramic artists and groups from around the world, and participate in hands-on classes for those aged four and above to experience the joy of pottery. The International Lecture Hall, in addition to scheduled film screenings, also hosts occasional academic and lecture events, and also offers venue rental services. The Information Center, a specialized library attached to the museum, houses books, journals, and audio-visual materials related to ceramics, art, and museums. The library's collection is also open to the public (books and other materials are not available for loan). The restaurant offers 152 seats in an elegant environment, allowing visitors to enjoy meals and drinks in a relaxed atmosphere.

globaltix_product_data.description: Easter, which symbolizes infinite hope and full of vitality, is coming soon. Taking advantage of the spring holiday, come and set foot on Ma Wan Island with your family and friends.Hong Kong Noah's Ark, enter the poetic dream world and feel the wonderful nature. Noah's Ark in Hong Kong March 29 to 31, April 1,4,6,7, 2024 (Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays), bringing you special events"Hua Mei Qi Yuan". Let young people of all ages develop their artistic talent and creativity, participate in special D.I.Y. workshops, and handcraft a series of spring and flower-themed boutiques that will make your heart bloom and turn them into thoughtful gifts. including sweet and cute ones"A diffuser stone shaped like a cute bee and a little honey pot", and can add aromatherapy essential oil of your choice to exude happy energy at all times; you can also draw colorful"Flower Painted Cup", allowing the feeling of spring to accompany you leisurely every day; you can also cleverly combine creativity and STEAM knowledge to create "free-flying" animals on the spot."Fantasy Flying Butterfly", lifelike, triggering endless surprises! You can also participate during the trip"Natural Footprint Hunting Tour",Travel through many interesting check-in attractions in the park, collect different forms of commemorative seals step by step, and use your design talents to create fresh and timeless natural paintings. Active children can also have fun"Children's Fun and Speedy Fun"high trucks and"Cute Animal Riding Fun", galloping in the spring breeze. If you want to indulge in the Easter holiday more, you can sit in the restaurant of Noah's Ark Resort Hotel and taste the perfect ""Flower Language and Sea View Afternoon Tea"with a dazzling array of"Colorful Easter Seafood Buffet", feel the endless taste of spring! Better to stay in a hotel"Mushroom Forest Theme Room", the room is filled with fairy tale style, and you can indulge in a fresh and refreshing journey. *Each two tickets purchased will receive a set of 10 game tokens (applicable to participating in some activities), some activities require additional charges/need to meet specific participation conditions

options.termsAndConditions: Hong Kong Ma Wan Park Noah's Ark Pet Ticket Pet-friendly activity guidelines: On regular opening days, visitors are welcome to bring their pets into the theme park area. A corresponding adult/concession/pet admission ticket must be purchased for entry to visit the attractions and/or participate in certain activities. Each pet admission ticket allows entry for one dog or other pet only. Dogs or other pets visiting the park must be accompanied and supervised by a person aged 18 or above. Each person aged 18 or above may bring a maximum of two dogs or other pets. If the limit is exceeded, the purchased admission tickets cannot be transferred, exchanged, or refunded. As the park is also open to other visitors, fighting dogs/dogs classified as dangerous breeds/snakes/spiders/insects are not allowed entry. We appreciate your understanding. Fighting dogs include pit bull terriers, Japanese Tosas, Argentine Dogos, Brazilian Filas, or any mixed breeds involving fighting dogs. The park reserves the right to deny entry to any pets displaying aggressive behavior or tendencies. All dogs must be vaccinated against rabies, possess a valid dog license issued by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, and be microchipped for identification. All dogs must have their microchips scanned upon entry and provide a copy or photo of their vaccination card for verification. All dogs must be fully vaccinated against common infectious diseases at least 14 days prior, including: Canine distemper, Canine parvovirus enteritis, and Other diseases requiring additional preventive measures as determined by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department Ma Wan is a 24-hour restricted vehicle zone. Private cars without a restricted area permit issued by the Transport Department are not allowed to enter. All participants please take note of the transportation arrangements. Pets are not allowed in any area of the restaurant. If needed, participants can bring their pets to designated outdoor/indoor leisure dining areas (pet-friendly meals require at least 3 days advance reservation). Each participant entering the venue and their accompanying pets must meet and comply with the relevant terms and conditions to gain entry and participate in the activity. For more detailed terms and conditions, please refer to the attached [Pet-Friendly Activity Guidelines]. "Large dogs" in public places must comply with the following control measures: "Large dogs must at all times be securely held on a leash not exceeding 2 meters in length..." options.termsAndConditions: Hong Kong Ma Wan Park Noah's Ark Pet Ticket Pet-friendly activity guidelines: On regular opening days, visitors are welcome to bring their pets into the theme park area. A corresponding adult/concession/pet admission ticket must be purchased for entry to visit the attractions and/or participate in certain activities. Each pet admission ticket allows entry for one dog or other pet only. Dogs or other pets visiting the park must be accompanied and supervised by a person aged 18 or above. Each person aged 18 or above may bring a maximum of two dogs or other pets. If the limit is exceeded, the purchased admission tickets cannot be transferred, exchanged, or refunded. As the park is also open to other visitors, fighting dogs/dogs classified as dangerous breeds/snakes/spiders/insects are not allowed entry. We appreciate your understanding. Fighting dogs include pit bull terriers, Japanese Tosas, Argentine Dogos, Brazilian Filas, or any mixed breeds involving fighting dogs. The park reserves the right to deny entry to any pets displaying aggressive behavior or tendencies. All dogs must be vaccinated against rabies, possess a valid dog license issued by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, and be microchipped for identification. All dogs must have their microchips scanned upon entry and provide a copy or photo of their vaccination card for verification. All dogs must be fully vaccinated against common infectious diseases at least 14 days prior, including: Canine distemper, Canine parvovirus enteritis, and Other diseases requiring additional preventive measures as determined by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department Ma Wan is a 24-hour restricted vehicle zone. Private cars without a restricted area permit issued by the Transport Department are not allowed to enter. All participants please take note of the transportation arrangements. Pets are not allowed in any area of the restaurant. If needed, participants can bring their pets to designated outdoor/indoor leisure dining areas (pet-friendly meals require at least 3 days advance reservation). Each participant entering the venue and their accompanying pets must meet and comply with the relevant terms and conditions to gain entry and participate in the activity. For more detailed terms and conditions, please refer to the attached [Pet-Friendly Activity Guidelines]. "Large dogs" in public places must comply with the following control measures: "Large dogs must at all times be securely held on a leash not exceeding 2 meters in length..." globaltix_product_data.summary: Ocean Park Hong Kong is a world-class marine-themed park located on Hong Kong Island, combining a theme park, aquarium, and wildlife attraction. Visitors can enjoy thrilling rides, interactive animal exhibits, and educational experiences in beautifully themed zones. The park features iconic attracti...
globaltix_product_data.description: Ocean Park Hong Kong is a world-class marine-themed park located on Hong Kong Island, combining a theme park, aquarium, and wildlife attraction. Visitors can enjoy thrilling rides, interactive animal exhibits, and educational experiences in beautifully themed zones. The park features iconic attractions such as roller coasters, marine life displays, and live shows. It is an ideal destination for families, thrill-seekers, and nature enthusiasts. The recommended duration is a full-day experience, typically 5–8 hours depending on your pace and interests. The visit is self-paced, allowing guests to explore different zones, enjoy rides, and attend shows at their convenience. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels, weather, and show schedules. Guests can enter the park by scanning their e-ticket or redeeming tickets at the entrance if required. Upon entry, visitors can explore multiple themed zones connected by cable car or funicular. Enjoy a mix of adrenaline-pumping rides, marine and wildlife exhibits, and scheduled performances. Guests can move freely throughout the park, plan their route based on show timings, and enjoy a full day of entertainment before exiting.
highlights: Enjoy thrilling rides, marine exhibits, and live shows in one of Hong Kong’s top theme parks.
Explore unique zones combining an oceanarium, wildlife park, and amusement rides in one destination.
Perfect for families, couples, and thrill-seekers seeking fun, education, and adventure.
Includes access to rides, animal exhibits, shows, and park attractions (subject to availability).
Ideal for visitors of all ages looking for a mix of excitement, learning, and entertainment.

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore faith through culture and art in the magnificent complex of the Cathedral of Siena. With a pass you can choose what you'd like to see most, from the crypt to the Opera Museum.See all of the Cathedral of Siena, including the Piccolomini Library, the Opera Museum, and the Baptistery. Other highlights include the Crypt, which contains some of the most important artworks in the whole complex, including bright paintings only discovered after recent renovations. The vibrant frescoes of the Piccolomini Library were done by Pinturicchio, likely based on designs by Raphael.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Oriental Pearl Radio & Television Tower is one of Shanghai’s most iconic landmarks, rising above the city skyline in Lujiazui. Known for its distinctive futuristic design and panoramic views, the tower offers visitors a unique perspective of Shanghai’s blend of modern architecture, historic districts, and the Huangpu River.
highlights: Enjoy 360-degree panoramic views of Shanghai from multiple observation decks
Experience the Glass Floor Skywalk for a thrilling view straight down
Visit themed exhibitions showcasing Shanghai’s history and urban development
Capture stunning photos of Pudong and Puxi from one of Shanghai’s most famous viewpoints

globaltix_product_data.summary: Versailles conjures up notions of a grand palace and vast landscaped gardens. But did you know there's also a third part? With this all-area-access ticket, you'll be able to explore the Hameau de la Reine, Marie Antoinette's private compound where she played pretend as a humble peasant. The main pal...
globaltix_product_data.description: Versailles conjures up notions of a grand palace and vast landscaped gardens. But did you know there's also a third part? With this all-area-access ticket, you'll be able to explore the Hameau de la Reine, Marie Antoinette's private compound where she played pretend as a humble peasant. The main palace and gardens are extravagant beyond belief. It boasts more than 700 rooms, 18th-century French art, an opera house, and a 75-meter-long hall of mirrors lined with statues and busts. The gardens feature all manner of luxuries and follies that a European monarch just couldn't do without: meticulously manicured lawns and ornate baroque fountains.But that's not all, Marie Antoinette also had her own compound away from the main palace. These are located near the Grand Trianon and Petit Trianon, which already existed on the edge of the grounds. Her idyllic village came to be known as The Queen's Hamlet, and was a fully-functioning village!
highlights: Walk through Marie Antoinette's private compound, the rustic Queens Hamlet modeled after a real French village
Amble through the landscaped gardens, the stunning Hall of Mirrors, the Royal Opera, and the Petit and Grand Trianon
Admire French Art and furniture in the baroque and Rococo style. Check out the many chests by André Charles Boulle!

globaltix_product_data.summary: The tramcar is the largest rotating aerial cabin in the world, and it turns twice during the ascent, so the view moves steadily around you — the walls of Chino Canyon rising close on either side, the desert floor and the whole Coachella Valley falling away below. The climb covers nearly six thousand...
globaltix_product_data.description: The tramcar is the largest rotating aerial cabin in the world, and it turns twice during the ascent, so the view moves steadily around you — the walls of Chino Canyon rising close on either side, the desert floor and the whole Coachella Valley falling away below. The climb covers nearly six thousand vertical feet in about ten minutes, and it passes through several distinct ecological zones on the way. You board among creosote and palms in desert heat and step out at 8,516 feet into pine forest, thirty to forty degrees cooler, with snow on the ground for much of the year. At the top, Mountain Station has viewing decks, two restaurants, a small natural history museum and the trailheads for more than fifty miles of paths through Mount San Jacinto State Park. Even a short walk from the station puts you in silence among the trees.

globaltix_product_data.name: Park Güell Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Park Güell is one of Antoni Gaudí's most joyful, colourful, and imaginatively exuberant creations — a UNESCO World Heritage garden and public park on the Carmel hill of Barcelona that was originally conceived as a residential garden city for the Catalan bourgeoisie before being transformed into the...
globaltix_product_data.description: Park Güell is one of Antoni Gaudí's most joyful, colourful, and imaginatively exuberant creations — a UNESCO World Heritage garden and public park on the Carmel hill of Barcelona that was originally conceived as a residential garden city for the Catalan bourgeoisie before being transformed into the extraordinary public space that has become one of the city's most beloved and internationally recognised landmarks. The park's most celebrated features — the serpentine mosaic bench of the main terrace, the gingerbread gatehouses at the main entrance, the forest of inclined stone columns supporting the terrace above, and the spectacular views across Barcelona to the Mediterranean — are explored with expert guided commentary that reveals the artistic thinking and architectural innovation behind each extraordinary element. The Amigo Tours guide brings Gaudí's creative philosophy to life at every stop — explaining the trencadís mosaic technique of broken ceramic tile, the structural logic of the inclined columns, and the way Gaudí drew inspiration from natural forms, organic structures, and the colours of the Catalan landscape in creating a park that feels simultaneously ancient and entirely unlike anything ever built before. Pre-secured entry tickets eliminate the challenge of independent procurement for this popular UNESCO attraction.
highlights: Visit the famous dragon staircase
Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Enjoy stunning views of Barcelona
Relax on the serpentine bench with panoramic views
Discover the colorful trencadís mosaics
Learn fascinating stories and secrets of Gaudí
Admire Gaudí’s masterpiece in a UNESCO World Heritage Site

globaltix_product_data.description: Parque Warner Beach is Madrid's most thrilling and comprehensively equipped water park — a spectacular summer leisure destination located within the Parque Warner Madrid resort complex in San Martín de la Vega, approximately 30 kilometres south of the Spanish capital. Spanning an expansive site of purpose-built water attractions, wave pools, lazy rivers, high-speed water slides, and dedicated children's play areas, Parque Warner Beach delivers one of the most complete and exhilarating aquatic entertainment experiences available anywhere in the Madrid region — combining the refreshing relief of world-class water attractions with the energy, excitement, and family-friendly entertainment that have made the broader Parque Warner resort one of Spain's most visited and beloved leisure destinations. The park's extensive range of attractions caters to every age group and thrill level — from the adrenaline-charged speed slides and multi-person raft rides that deliver the park's most intense aquatic experiences to the relaxed wave pool, lazy river, and children's splash zones that provide equally rewarding but more gently paced water leisure for families with younger guests. The Parque Warner Beach season typically runs from late spring through to early autumn — coinciding with Madrid's long and intensely sunny summer season that makes the park's water attractions a genuinely essential and deeply satisfying refuge from the heat. The park is easily accessible from Madrid by private vehicle or shuttle service and can be combined with a visit to the adjacent Parque Warner Madrid theme park for an extraordinary full day of dual entertainment.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The museum stands on Ford Island, in the middle of the harbour, inside hangars that were there on the morning of 7 December 1941. globaltix_product_data.description: The museum stands on Ford Island, in the middle of the harbour, inside hangars that were there on the morning of 7 December 1941. Hangar 79 still has its original blue glass panes, shattered by strafing fire and left unrepaired — you can put your hand near the holes. Inside Hangar 37, the story of the attack is told through the aircraft themselves: a Japanese A6M2 Zero, a P-40 Warhawk, and a Stearman trainer in which a civilian flying lesson was interrupted by the first wave. Hangar 79 holds the later decades — MiGs, an F-15, helicopters from Vietnam and the Gulf — plus a restoration shop where volunteers work in full view. The restored Ford Island control tower, which directed traffic that morning, is open to climb. From the top you look out over the harbour, the Battleship Missouri and the Arizona Memorial, with the whole shape of the day laid out below you.

The result is a stunning 30-acre cultural theme park that has become the ultimate in night-time entertainment on the resort island of Phuket. globaltix_product_data.summary: Are you an art lover and would like to discover the works of one of the most important artists of the 20th Century? globaltix_product_data.description: Are you an art lover and would like to discover the works of one of the most important artists of the 20th Century? Then you can miss this guided tour of the Picasso Museum in Barcelona. The meeting point will be at the Fossar de les Moreres. From there, we will head towards the Picasso Museum on a nice and short walk. Although the Picasso Museum was initially housed in a single building, the “Palau Aguilar”, it was extended over the years. It is currently made up of five different palaces, built between the 13th and 14th Centuries. Once inside the Picasso Museum we will learn about his artistic evolution, from his youth to his death, discovering also his period in Barcelona between 1895 and 1904. Did you know the Picasso Museum was the first and only museum created during the artist’s lifetime? It is the perfect place to discover all the details of the artist’s life and career. Appreciate his artistic evolution through the collection of more than 3.500 works and the most complete in the world of works from his youth. With your guide’s explanations, you will learn about the five periods that market Picasso’s lifetime: the blue, pink, cubist, neoclassical and surrealist periods. At the end of the guided tour, you can stay inside the museum for as long as you like, to admire all the works
