globaltix_product_data.summary: America's first wax museum opened in St. Augustine in 1949, and it still occupies its place by the old city gate. More than a hundred and sixty figures fill the galleries, each one sculpted, haired and finished by hand using techniques that have barely changed in a century. The collection ranges wid...
globaltix_product_data.description: America's first wax museum opened in St. Augustine in 1949, and it still occupies its place by the old city gate. More than a hundred and sixty figures fill the galleries, each one sculpted, haired and finished by hand using techniques that have barely changed in a century. The collection ranges wide — presidents and monarchs, explorers and scientists, religious figures, film stars and musicians — with displays explaining how the figures are made, from the clay head and the glass eyes to the individually inserted hairs. A separate gallery given over to horror and film monsters is the part most visitors remember, and photographs are encouraged throughout. It takes about an hour, sits directly on the walking route into the old town, and is pleasantly cool on a hot Florida afternoon.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. globaltix_product_data.description: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. Of course, when that clock is a 600-year-old marvel of medieval engineering it's worth it. However, this skip-the-line ticket gets you right to the front of the line, so you can visit the Gothic clock tower, and see the insides of the world's oldest operational astronomical clock.Time flies when you're having fun, so make sure you get into the fast lane to see Prague's world-famous Astronomical Clock. Meet your guide in the quaint Old Town Square to pick up your tickets. Rain or shine, the guide will be holding an open blue and white umbrella. And then visit the clock. Every hour a small trapdoor opens and Christ himself marches out, followed by his disciples. The Grim Reaper also rings a bell - checking to see whose time has come (unsurprisingly, everyone shakes their heads 'no'). There are also planetary motion, the zodiac and more on the clock - and 75% of its parts are original - like original.With your tickets, you'll get to skip the lines and take the stairs or an elevator up the tower. From there you'll have amazing views over the Old Town Square and the rest of Prague's Old Town.On your way back down to Prague, you can think on the staying power of this clock. It's an appropriate occasion to call to mind the words of English essayist Henry Austin Dobson: we .That ought to encourage you to make the most of your time in Prague.

Qasr Al Watan houses the offices of the President, Vice President and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi. Qasr Al Watan is the epitome of beauty, grace and marvelous architecture. You would get to visit the beautiful rooms of the palace including the library, the Great Hall, the Barza (the royal banquet), etc. You would also be able to attend interactive cultural exhibitions, view rare manuscripts and artifacts, and witness the contribution of Arabs in the fields of humanities, science, literature and arts. If you want to be mesmerized by the beauty and architecture of Qasr Al Watan, do contact us to buy tickets and arrange transportation.

globaltix_product_data.summary: “Have I really been here for three hours?” - this might be the only question left unanswered after your visit to this brand new attraction in the heart of Amsterdam. There’s so much to see and do that you’ll wish you had four eyes, like a certain Chinese gentleman you'll meet. Step into this delight...
globaltix_product_data.description: “Have I really been here for three hours?” - this might be the only question left unanswered after your visit to this brand new attraction in the heart of Amsterdam. There’s so much to see and do that you’ll wish you had four eyes, like a certain Chinese gentleman you'll meet. Step into this delightful time sink - and good luck with that @#$%&! mystery gate!Robert Ripley toured the world, returning with surprising information and peculiar artifacts. At Ripley’s Believe It or Not Amsterdam you can benefit from his years of hard work as you wander the five floors of (nearly) unbelievable artifacts. Start at the entrance, by taking a selfie with the world’s tallest man. And then dive deeper and deeper into a comprehensive collection of fascinating oddities. From a Ghanese coffin in the shape of a flying car, to an intricate sculpture made entirely of cutlery, this exhibition will beguile, baffle and delight. Plus, if you’re scared of the dentist, the terrifying 19th century tooth extractor will show just how good you have it! Altogether, there are more than 500 exhibits and artifacts organized in 19 themed galleries - but don't worry, there's a clear path guiding you through the building. You can spend as much time as you want analyzing the contents of each room before moving to the next one. Learn how to shrink a human head in the jungle gallery, then go to the creepy chamber (unless you're too chicken) and see which torture enthusiast inspired Bram Stoker to create Count Dracula.Whether you’re familiar with curator Robert Ripley’s legacy or not, this place will grab your attention and hold onto it for hours. Say hello to weirdness, and goodbye to whatever else you had planned for the afternoon.

Explore 19 themed galleries packed full of curious delights and wax figures of real people that Mr. Ripley encountered in the 201 countries he visited
Interact with dozens of attractions, like the brain-twisting vortex tunnel, the shooting gallery, and the rage-inducing mystery gate

globaltix_product_data.description: Billed as Hawaii's largest live show, and staged with a scale to match — a full theatre production in the middle of Waikiki, with a live band, elaborate costume changes and a cast working through the dance traditions of the Pacific. The first half moves across Polynesia: Hawaiian hula, the fast drumming and hip work of Tahiti, Maori haka, and Samoan fire knife spun and thrown in near-darkness. The second half changes gear entirely into tribute performances, with impersonations of Elvis Presley and Michael Jackson that are considerably better than they have any need to be. Dinner packages add a buffet of Hawaiian and Pacific Rim dishes served beforehand, along with lei making, crafts and photographs during the pre-show. The venue sits inside the Royal Hawaiian Center, so most Waikiki guests simply walk over.

globaltix_product_data.description: Get a ticket to the Royal Alcázar of Seville, and marvel at this stunning medieval Islamic palace. Walk around and admire the stunning architecture and the beautiful gardens. Originally developed as a fort for the Cordoban governors of Seville in 913, the Royal Alcázar of Seville is an amazing fusion of Christian and Moorish architecture. It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987, and it has been renovated numerous times over the 11 centuries since its creation. Learn about how the Christian king Fernando III moved into the Alcázar when he captured Seville in 1248 and how several monarchs used the palace as their main residence. globaltix_product_data.description: Keeping up with the Joneses? Surely, one proud royal family would never seek to out-do another? Whether it was built to rival Versailles or not is a moot point, for The Royal Palace of Caserta is truly vast and monumental. By at least one measurement it’s the largest royal palace ever built. A two-hour train ride from Rome, this palace and gardens combo is the perfect destination for a daytrip.The Royal Palace of Caserta is an absolute marvel - not only the largest royal palace in Europe, a visit here will also give you a delightful sense of déjà vu. Having featured in Star Wars II: Attack of the Clones, Mission Impossible III and other blockbuster movies, it is both cinematic and memorable. With Royal Apartments, lush formal gardens (including a park and English Garden), and a number of opulent water features, there's more than enough here to warrant the journey from Rome.

globaltix_product_data.description: Check in at our office and head to the Royal Palace with your guide, just two minutes walking distance from the same. Skip the lines and dive right into the history of this beautiful palace. Did you know its size doubles the one of Buckingham Palace? Build in an Italian baroque style; it was the former residence of the Spanish Monarchy from 1766 to 1931. Nowadays, it still is a great example of the establishment of Madrid as the capital of the kingdom. Today, it holds the most important receptions of the Spanish Crown. Know the audiences, dinner parties and signature of agreements celebrated through the years. Walk around the Armory Square. Marvel at the beautiful tapestries and elegant furniture. Follow your guide through the Grand Staircase, the Throne Room and the Banqueting Hall, among others. Once your guided visit finishes, you can visit the Royal Armory on your own. Make sure not to miss the views from the viewpoint of the Armory square!

globaltix_product_data.description: Check in at our office and head to the Royal Palace with your guide, just two minutes walking distance from the same. Skip the lines and dive right into the history of this beautiful palace. Did you know its size doubles the one of Buckingham Palace? Build in an Italian baroque style; it was the former residence of the Spanish Monarchy from 1766 to 1931. Nowadays, it still is a great example of the establishment of Madrid as the capital of the kingdom. Today, it holds the most important receptions of the Spanish Crown. Know the audiences, dinner parties and signature of agreements celebrated through the years. Walk around the Armory Square. Marvel at the beautiful tapestries and elegant furniture. Follow your guide through the Grand Staircase, the Throne Room and the Banqueting Hall, among others. Once your guided visit finishes, you can visit the Royal Armory on your own. Make sure not to miss the views from the viewpoint of the Armory square!

Discover one of Spain's most iconic experiences with an expert local guide
Enjoy a well-organised itinerary that makes the most of your time
Tour the opulent Royal Palace of Madrid
Perfect for travellers who want to explore beyond the usual highlights

globaltix_product_data.description: The Sacred Monkey Forest is more than just a monkey-filled jungle. The sanctuary is rooted in the Balinese philosophy of Tri Hita Karana, which promotes harmony between people, nature, and spirit. You’ll find beautifully maintained pathways, moss-covered statues, and sacred spaces that locals still use for daily rituals. Whether you're here for the wildlife, the cultural insight, or the peaceful jungle setting, the Sacred Monkey Forest offers a unique glimpse into Bali’s natural and spiritual beauty. Best of all, your visit helps support conservation and local community programs—so you can feel good while exploring this magical place.

globaltix_product_data.description: Safari Lagoi Bintan is located in Bintan Beach International Resorts, a well known integrated tourism resorts in Bintan Island. The existence of Safari Lagoi is complementary to tourist destination options and become healthful, natural and educative family entertainment facility in Bintan Island. Safari Lagoi is a centre for refuge for endangered Indonesian fauna. The animals and birds on display here are mainly rescued from illegal pet trade and exotic meat markets, confiscated from ‘owners’ by the relevant Indonesian Government Authorities or are sick / injured animals being nursed back to health. Most of these animals and birds are judged to be incapable of being released back into the wild for a variety of reasons and hence need to be cared for at this centre.

globaltix_product_data.description: Start the tour from our office next to Sagrada Familia. Remember you must check in at least 15 minutes before the starting time of the activity. An experienced guide will pick you up from the office and walk you to the Basilica. Enter the monument and discover the ultimate must-see landmark in Barcelona. Learn about the history and significance of Sagrada Familia by the hand of your local guide. Marvel at the astonishing interior, rich in symbolism inspired on natural wonders. Walk freely around the nave whilst listening to your guide’s explanations of Gaudí’s masterpiece on your headsets. Take in all the details of the perfect fusion between architecture and spirituality. globaltix_product_data.description: Start the tour from our office next to Sagrada Familia. Remember you must check in at least 15 minutes before the starting time of the activity. An experienced guide will pick you up from the office and walk you to the Basilica. Enter the monument and discover the ultimate must-see landmark in Barcelona. Learn about the history and significance of Sagrada Familia by the hand of your local guide. Marvel at the astonishing interior, rich in symbolism inspired on natural wonders. Walk freely around the nave whilst listening to your guide’s explanations of Gaudí’s masterpiece on your headsets. Take in all the details of the perfect fusion between architecture and spirituality. Tour the outside façades and wonder at the magnificence of details. At the end of your tour, you can stay inside Sagrada Familia and visit the museum. An exhibition of drawings, models and pictures narrate the story of the Basilica. The museum also displays information on Gaudí’s life and career. At the end of the tour, your guide will take you to the elevator entrance for you to go up one of the towers by yourself. Admire the panoramic views over Barcelona. Will you miss it out?

globaltix_product_data.summary: When modern Paris has overwhelmed you with its boutiques, bicycles, and baguettes, step back in time at two of its most interesting and historical landmarks in medieval Palais de la Cité - once the residence of the Kings of France. Sainte Chappelle with its mesmerizing stained glass windows was home...
globaltix_product_data.description: When modern Paris has overwhelmed you with its boutiques, bicycles, and baguettes, step back in time at two of its most interesting and historical landmarks in medieval Palais de la Cité - once the residence of the Kings of France. Sainte Chappelle with its mesmerizing stained glass windows was home to Christ's Crown of Thorns, while the Conciergerie was home, or rather prison to Marie-Antoinette! See two stunning monuments from France's past - a 13th century church with brilliant stained glass windows, and a medieval royal palace that was formerly home to French royalty. NOTE: All visitors need to pass through security checks. (Sainte-Chapelle) Standing proudly on the Ile de la Cite, this intimate chapel and UNESCO World Heritage site was consecrated on April 26, 1248. It was commissioned by King Louis IX, who wanted somewhere nice to house his collection of religious relics, including Christ’s Crown of Thorns. This Gothic chapel is renowned for its collection of 15 gorgeous stained glass windows, depicting 1,113 scenes from the Old and New Testaments - as well as a pane showing the relocation of the Relics to Paris, prominently featuring the church's patron King Louis. On a sunny day, the light streaming in through those windows makes you forgive every drop of rain that ever fell on Paris. (Conciergerie) This medieval royal palace was abandoned by the Kings of France at the end of the 14th century (settling in the Louvre and Vincennes held more appeal), at which point it became a prison and revolutionary tribunal. It was one of the principal places of detention throughout the French Revolution (when it was known as "the antechamber to the guillotine"). That statement was certainly true in the case of its most famous resident, former Queen Marie Antoinette. As you wander the Salle des Gardes (Guards Room) and the immense Salle des Gens d'armes (Hall of the Soldiers) consider how she must have felt being imprisoned here. Her commemorative chapel was erected on the site of her cell in the renovation. {Histopad (Conciergerie)} Discover the medieval and revolutionary rooms (as well as the spaces that have disappeared) with the Histopad, an augmented reality tool that allows you to go back in time.
highlights: Be amazed by the Sainte-Chapelle - the finest royal chapel to be built in France, and marvel at the remarkable 15-meter high stained glass windows
Visit one of the main detention centers of the French Revolution, The Conciergerie, and the memorial chapel to its most famous prisoner, Marie-Antoinette.
Discover two of Paris's major historical attractions in the Palais de la Cité, once the residence of the Kings of France until the 14th century
inclusions: Histopad for the Conciergerie, available until 16:30 in French, English, Spanish, German, Italian and Chinese
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: After the mandatory security check, go straight to the ticket holders line and show your smartphone ticket. globaltix_product_data.description: Step inside one of the world’s most legendary football stadiums with a guided tour of San Siro Stadium and Museum in Milan. Home to both AC Milan and Inter Milan, this iconic venue—also known as “La Scala del Calcio”—offers an unforgettable behind-the-scenes experience for football fans. Explore exclusive areas usually reserved for players and officials, including the dressing rooms, mixed zone, and players’ tunnel. Walk onto the pitchside and feel the excitement of match day while learning fascinating stories and history from your guide. Complete your visit at the San Siro Museum, where you’ll discover an impressive collection of memorabilia, jerseys, and trophies that celebrate the rich football heritage of Milan and Italy.

globaltix_product_data.description: Dress in your best and get ready for a night of classic romance with the Schönbrunn Palace Festival Orchestra. Music by Strauss and Mozart will enchant you (the latter actually performed here in 1786) accompanied by special dance and vocal performances. A true cultural spectacular!The Orangery Schönbrunn is a special place once used for glittering court festivities like banquets and concerts. Not much has changed.In a truly special night out, let the incredible Schönbrunn Palace Festival Orchestra and the Schönbrunn Palace Festival Ensemble wow you in this traditional venue as they perform classic pieces by Mozart and Strauss. Emphasizing the beauty of the work are two opera singers, and two graceful ballet dancers.Enter the orangery, and get swept away into a musical world of imperial delights.

globaltix_product_data.description: Dive into a world of underwater wonder at SEA LIFE Kelly Tarlton's, located in Auckland, New Zealand. This unique aquarium isn't your average tank display. Here, you'll embark on an unforgettable journey through the Southern Ocean, all housed within repurposed sewage tanks! Explore incredible marine biodiversity, from the playful antics of penguins to the awe-inspiring grace of sharks. Stroll through the Antarctic Ice Adventure, home to New Zealand's only colony of Subantarctic penguins. Witness these charismatic birds up close in their icy domain. Feel the thrill of walking through a transparent underwater tunnel, surrounded by a mesmerizing ballet of sharks, stingrays, and a dazzling array of tropical fish. SEA LIFE Kelly Tarlton's offers more than just stunning displays. Interactive exhibits allow you to learn about the delicate balance of the ocean ecosystem and the importance of marine conservation. Don't miss the opportunity to witness the fascinating creatures of the rockpool or the majestic beauty of the seahorses in their dedicated kingdom. SEA LIFE Kelly Tarlton's is an educational and entertaining experience for the whole family. It promises to spark a sense of wonder and inspire you to protect our precious oceans.
highlights: Encounter marine life native to New Zealand's waters.
Explore the underwater world within repurposed sewage tanks!
Walk through a transparent tunnel surrounded by sharks, stingrays, and tropical fish.
See New Zealand's only colony of Subantarctic penguins up close.

globaltix_product_data.summary: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in F...
globaltix_product_data.description: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in Florida. Mako runs long and fast in the classic hypercoaster style. Manta flies you face down with your arms out, skimming water. Kraken loops without a floor beneath your feet, Ice Breaker launches backwards and forwards, and Pipeline makes you stand up and surf. Between them the park curves around a central lake with shaded paths, quick-service kitchens and sit-down restaurants. Animal presentations run to a timetable throughout the day, and after dark the whole waterfront lights up for shows and fireworks.

This interactive theme attraction combines cutting-edge 4D technology with motion seats, wind, water, and special effects. Guests can enjoy action-packed rides and simulations, including virtual roller coasters and adventure journeys. It is a perfect destination for families, friends, and thrill-seekers looking for fun in a compact yet exciting setting. The recommended duration is approximately 1–2 hours, depending on the number of experiences selected and crowd levels. The attraction is generally self-paced, allowing guests to enter each show or ride based on availability and queue times. Actual duration may vary during peak periods or holidays. Guests can enter directly using a e-ticket for seamless admission or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Upon entry, visitors can enjoy multiple 4D shows and rides such as immersive motion simulators, interactive shooting rides, and cinematic experiences enhanced with special effects. Each attraction offers a unique storyline and sensory engagement. Guests typically proceed from one experience to another within the venue, making it an easy and enjoyable indoor activity suitable for all ages.

globaltix_product_data.name: Shrek’s Adventure! London
globaltix_product_data.summary: Shrek's Adventure! London is one of the British capital's most beloved and imaginatively immersive family entertainment experiences — a unique and thoroughly entertaining walkthrough attraction located on London's South Bank at County Hall, steps from the London Eye and the Thames waterfront, that i...
globaltix_product_data.description: Shrek's Adventure! London is one of the British capital's most beloved and imaginatively immersive family entertainment experiences — a unique and thoroughly entertaining walkthrough attraction located on London's South Bank at County Hall, steps from the London Eye and the Thames waterfront, that invites guests of all ages to step directly into the enchanted fairy tale world of DreamWorks Animation's most celebrated franchise. Far more than a conventional theme park or exhibition, Shrek's Adventure! is a fully immersive live-action storytelling experience in which guests become active participants in a new and original Shrek story — guided through a sequence of elaborately designed themed rooms and environments by costumed live actors, state-of-the-art 4D bus ride technology, and interactive animated story segments that blend physical theatrical performance with the most advanced digital entertainment technology available at any walkthrough attraction in London. The experience follows an original adventure narrative in which guests are magically transported to the Far Far Away kingdom and must navigate a series of fairy tale encounters — meeting familiar DreamWorks characters including Shrek, Donkey, Princess Fiona, Puss in Boots, and a colourful cast of fairy tale characters in lavishly detailed sets — before ultimately finding their way back home. The attraction's signature 4D flying theatre bus ride provides the experience's most technologically sophisticated and sensorially immersive dimension — the motion-platform vehicle combining wraparound projection, wind effects, scent, and physical movement for a genuinely exhilarating fairy tale journey. Located in one of London's most iconic and accessible riverside locations and designed for families with children of all ages, Shrek's Adventure! consistently delivers one of the most joyful, characterful, and memorably entertaining family experiences available anywhere in the United Kingdom.
highlights: Located on London's South Bank at County Hall — steps from the London Eye and Thames waterfront in one of the city's most iconic riverside locations.
A fully immersive family experience unlike any other in London — guests become active participants in an original Shrek story from start to finish.
Experience the signature 4D flying theatre bus ride — motion platform, wraparound projection, wind, scent, and special effects in a thrilling fairy tale journey
Step into the world of Shrek in an original live-action fairy tale adventure — immersive themed rooms, costumed characters, and interactive storytelling through
Meet Shrek, Donkey, Puss in Boots, and beloved DreamWorks fairy tale characters in lavishly detailed sets of extraordinary creative and theatrical quality.

globaltix_product_data.description: Begin the ultimate travel experience around Lion City with this unique Singapore Cable Car promotion. Take to the skies and enjoy unparalleled views of Singapore's top attractions from Mount Faber Park to Sentosa Island. Start or end your journey at Mount Faber, located near Bukit Merah and one of Singapore's oldest hilltop parks. Ride on a cable car in Singapore with your Sky Pass and access all six stations across the Sentosa Line and the Mount Faber Line. Get the Sky Pass with Meal deal and enjoy a daily set lunch at Arbora Hilltop Garden & Bistro, a unique restaurant offering the perfect dining experience and majestic views of Sentosa, or dinner at Good Old Days Restaurant, a family-friendly halal restaurant offering wok-made stir-fried vegetables and aromatic dishes.
highlights: Location: The only cableway that links Mount Faber, HarbourFront, and Sentosa Island.
Experience: Fly on board the Singapore Cable Car and enjoy the amazing aerial views that unfold all around you from 100 meters above sea level.
Duration: Each ride lasts around 30 minutes.
New Cable Cars: New spherical cable cars with transparent bottoms will be unveiled in Feb 2024 but will run in 2nd quarter of the year.
inclusions: Cable car ride on both the Sentosa Line and Mount Faber Line

globaltix_product_data.summary: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, th...
globaltix_product_data.description: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, the attraction connects meaningful marine education with real-world applications. Singapore Oceanarium is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA) and is a member of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA) and Southeast Asian Zoo and Aquarium Association (SEAZA) — a testament to its commitment to inspiring generations of ocean stewards. Beyond its exhibits, Singapore Oceanarium is home to a Research and Learning Centre featuring advanced, purpose-built spaces for research, conservation, and community outreach. Certified by Singapore's Building and Construction Authority as a Green Mark Platinum Zero Energy building, the centre runs entirely on solar energy, with environmental sustainability at its core. The attraction is also dedicated to advancing marine education and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened species through long-term partnerships with institutes worldwide. This summer, experience the ocean like never before with the exclusive Cry Me an Ocean activation by POP MART — the largest activation to date at Singapore Oceanarium. Running from 24 June to 30 August 2026, guests can explore seven newly created marine-themed CRYBABY characters brought to life through larger-than-life inflatables, sculptures, and photo zones across Singapore Oceanarium, WEAVE, and an ocean-themed POP-Up store by POP MART. Specially designed installations placed alongside real marine habitats offer a fun and immersive way to connect with the wonders of the ocean
highlights: One of the world’s largest kreisel tanks, home to over 5,000 moon jellyfish, offering a mesmerizing, ethereal display
A recreated mangrove habitat featuring interactive, touch‑friendly displays showcasing native biodiversity
Features life‑sized animatronics and fossils of prehistoric marine creatures, tracing evolution from primeval seas to land
A deep‑sea display portraying how whale carcasses nurture entire ecosystems, using immersive visuals and real habitats
A breathtaking 36‑metre‑wide viewing panel where reef manta rays and zebra sharks glide before your eyes

Operating hours: 

  • 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week

Duration:

  • 1 Day Pass - Unlimited rides during operating hours

Route

  • Approximately 23 km of Singapore’s southern coastline, covering Resorts World Sentosa and Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach)

Vessel Capacity

  • Up to 50 passengers

Suitable For

  • Ages 4 and above

Good to Know

  • Life jackets provided for all guests. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and light clothing. Operating hours and departure schedules may vary depending on weather and sea conditions.

How long does the cruise take?

  • RWS–OBC or OBC–RWS --- Approximately 15 minutes (single hop).
  • RWS–OBC–RWS or OBC–RWS–OBC --- Approximately 30 minutes (two single hops).
  • OBC–Southern Islands–OBC --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip).
  • RWS–OBC–Southern Islands–OBC–RWS --- Approximately 1 hour (Round Trip)
  • RWS–RWS (Non‐Stop) --- Approximately 1 hour (round trip). 12 pm to 6 pm (Hourly sails), 7 days a week

Boarding and hop-off points include:

  • RWS (adjacent to Singapore Oceanarium exit)
  • Ola Beach Club, Siloso Beach
  • Lazarus Island
  • Kusu Island
  • Sisters’ Islands

Note: 

  • RWS = Resorts World Sentosa
  • OBC = Ola Beach Club
  • SI = Southern Islands (Lazarus, Kusu, Sisters)

options.termsAndConditions:
Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass (1-Day Unlimited Speedboat Rides)

  • This ticket is valid starting from 12th December 2025
  • This ticket are valid for 3 months from the date of purchase, and prices are not guaranteed until the ticket is issued.
  • Younger children are permitted however the parent/guardian will be required to sign a liabilty waiver and comply with certain requirements.
  • Operating hours: 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM, with hourly sailings, 7 days a week.
  • Sailing times and routes are subject to weather, sea conditions, and operational requirements.
  • Guests may board the next available boat without prior reservation. Average waiting time is under 30 minutes.
  • Children are permitted; however, it is recommended that they are at least 4 years old.
  • Younger children may travel subject to a signed liability waiver and compliance with safety requirements.
  • Life jackets (including child sizes), life rings, and flotation devices are provided onboard.
  • Maximum capacity: up to 50 passengers per boat.
  • All vessels are licensed as Singapore Passenger Harbour Craft (SP) under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore.

globaltix_product_data.description: Milan's National Museum of Science and Technology () is housed in a 16th-century monastery, and features a collection of more than 16,000 items - including models based on da Vinci's engineering sketches. It's a fascinating place to delve into the mind of whiz-genius overachiever da Vinci, and learn about cutting-edge tech.Leonardo da Vinci was a true Renaissance man (and not just because he was alive during the Italian Renaissance). His interests ranged from the study of nature and anatomy to military and hydraulic engineering. Not only a renowned painter, he's often credited with inventing the parachute, helicopter and tank. His observations and ideas can be seen in the thousands of drawings made throughout his life and career as painter and engineer.And Milan's National Museum of Science and Technology is a fitting tribute: huge and filled with experiments on subjects from energy to communication, its scope seems to reflect the great man's restless mind. There are seven different departments, each of which studies and researches in the areas of their collection, as well as creating exhibitions and educational activities. Highlights include the New Frontiers Department, with its space area (including a chunk of moon rock),the Ocean Liner and the submarine .Kids in particular love the engaging interactivity, but really the whole family will find the time flying by, the way da Vinci hoped his 'ornithopter' would. Come curious and leave engaged and informed (and even more curious). A hot tip: the museum is so engaging that you can easily spend a whole day here - so long as you keep the blood sugar up. There's no café, but if you pack lunch and/or snacks you can avoid eating lunch out of a vending machine, and watch your child's eyes grow wide with wonder all day long.

options.description: Experience Queenstown's spectacular historic and scenic Skippers Canyon on this exciting 3 hour experience including 30 minute jet boat ride. The guided tour begins with return hotel transfers from Queenstown to Skippers Canyon via the infamous Skippers Canyon Road with informative commentary as you venture into this region that is rich in gold mining history. Half of the fun is the adventure to the upper Shotover River where you will join the jet boat ride. Take in spectacular scenery along the way. Once you reach the boat, you will zip past narrow canyons and sheer rock walls with spectacular scenery at speeds of 80 kmph. Enjoy 360 degree spins, twist and turns throughout the 30 minute jet boat ride. Guided jet boat ride tours are held twice daily with additional tours available in summer. Tours depart from The Station Building in central Queenstown and visitors should allow 3 hours for the entire experience. Don't miss out on this high speed jet boat adventure along Skippers Canyon. globaltix_product_data.description: The Kuala Selangor Sasaran Beach is affectionately called Sky Mirror due to its mirror-like reflection of the sky. This mysterious ‘island’ can be reached via a bumpy boat ride and was once one of Kuala Selangor’s best-kept secrets. The Sky Mirror is actually a vast sand bar that appears above the sea surface during low sea tide, allowing you to indulge in unparalleled views of the sky and sea. Besides looking up, don’t forget to also look down at your feet and you’ll likely catch sight of sea creatures scattered abundantly in the sand such as tiny crabs, baby clams, sea grapes, and a variety of beautiful shells. Enjoy a picturesque day at the Sky Mirror Sasaran Beach where you'll be able to capture numerous Instagrammable shots of your reflection on the shallow waters. As the Sky Mirror is located 30 minutes away from Kuala Selangor in the open sea, you can only get here by joining a boat tour offered by various tour companies. Book your tour on Klook to enjoy the best rates! This Kuala Selangor Sky Mirror tour comes with a Sky Mirror Sasaran Beach boat ride ticket, meals & beverages and insurance as well.

globaltix_product_data.summary: St. Augustine was founded by the Spanish in 1565, which makes it the oldest continuously occupied European settlement in the United States — and this museum covers the four centuries that most visitors, busy photographing the fort, never quite get to. The galleries move through Timucua and Seminole...
globaltix_product_data.description: St. Augustine was founded by the Spanish in 1565, which makes it the oldest continuously occupied European settlement in the United States — and this museum covers the four centuries that most visitors, busy photographing the fort, never quite get to. The galleries move through Timucua and Seminole material culture, the Spanish founding and its long colonial aftermath, the British interval, and the city's late nineteenth-century reinvention as a winter resort for wealthy northerners under Henry Flagler. Salvage and shipwreck artefacts, weapons, tools and domestic objects fill the cases. It is modest in scale and easily seen in an hour, which suits its position in the cluster of attractions just north of the old city gate — a short walk from the Castillo de San Marcos and the pedestrian length of St. George Street.

Apart from sporting events, the stadium also hosts international shows. The Rolling Stones were the first group to perform at the Stade de France. International stars such as Madonna and ACDC also chose this venue for their concerts, witnessed by 80,000 spectators each time. End your visit at the museum, where you’ll find heaps of items that are testament to the stadium’s legendary history. On display are archives, models, autographed guitars, jerseys and much more. On this unique tour you’ll be able to follow the footsteps of football legends Zidane and Ronaldo, who played the 1998 FIFA World Cup final. This is also the site where Cristiano Ronaldo lifted his first major Trophy for Portugal! Includes : - Disabled access - Guided tour in French or English (depending on option chosen) - Exclusive behind-the-scenes access at the Stade de France - Free admission to the Stade de France Museum What’s Not Included : - Personal expenses - Transfers - Tips

globaltix_product_data.description: The NYC Statue of Liberty Sunset Cruise Ticket offers a relaxing evening sightseeing experience along the Hudson River and New York Harbor. Departing from South Street Seaport, this scenic cruise takes you past Lower Manhattan’s iconic skyline as the city transitions from golden sunset hues to dazzling night lights, creating a truly memorable atmosphere. During the 90-minute cruise, guests sail close to the Statue of Liberty for stunning photo opportunities while also passing famous landmarks such as the Brooklyn Bridge and One World Trade Center. With music playing onboard and unobstructed views from spacious outdoor decks, the experience blends sightseeing with a laid-back, enjoyable ambiance. The cruise operates on a fixed schedule and lasts approximately 1.5 hours. Guests check in at the designated pier and can board easily using mobile tickets. The experience is self-contained, with both indoor climate-controlled seating and open-air decks available, ensuring comfort in all seasons while enjoying panoramic views of New York City.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Sumida Aquarium is located on the 5th and 6th floors of the Tokyo Skytree. This urban aquarium has more than 10,000 species of marine life. The museum reproduces the "Tokyo Great Water Tank" in the Ogasawara Sea, a World Heritage Site, and an open indoor water tank. You can see penguins and fur seals, the aquarium also has a jellyfish tank and a research laboratory. The Cradle of Life takes the sea of the "Tokyo Islands" as its theme, and reproduces the "Tokyo Grand Tank". Watching whale sharks and various fish swimming in the water, it seems that the marine world of the Ogasawara Islands is in front of you. Playing with Water and Life This is the largest open indoor water tank in Japan, with a water volume of about 350 tons. There are penguins and fur seals living in a large water tank, and you can observe them up close. The exhibition space is connected through two floors, shortening the distance between tourists and animals, and using LED lighting, you can not only watch them move during the day, but also observe penguins sleeping at night. Aquarium Restaurant There is a penguin cafe in the aquarium, providing snacks, desserts, soft drinks, and a place for tourists to rest.
highlights: Discover over 10,000 marine creatures in a modern urban aquarium.
Explore immersive exhibits inspired by the UNESCO-listed Ogasawara Sea.
See penguins and fur seals up close in Japan's largest open indoor tank.
Admire beautiful jellyfish displays and learn about marine conservation.
Relax at the Penguin Café with snacks, desserts, and drinks.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Important Information: The facility may be temporarily closed due to severe weather or maintenance work. This ticket does not require a designated date and time Please check the official opening hours before your visit, as they may change due to seasonal events or maintenance. Children must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times. Photography for personal use is permitted unless otherwise indicated in specific exhibition areas. Flash photography, selfie sticks, tripods, and drones are not permitted inside the aquarium. Do not tap on the glass or disturb the animals. Eating and drinking are only permitted in designated areas, such as the Penguin Café. Smoking is prohibited throughout the aquarium. Re-entry may not be permitted after exiting the aquarium. Please follow all instructions provided by aquarium staff for the safety of visitors and animals. Additional information: The operating hours on March 12 are from 10:00 to 18:30, with the last admission at 17:30. Business hours may be adjusted periodically, so please check the official website for updates: https://www.sumida-aquarium.com/index.html

globaltix_product_data.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
globaltix_product_data.summary: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, t...
globaltix_product_data.description: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, that redefines what an observation experience can be through a spectacular combination of glass-enclosed outdoor terraces, indoor mirror and glass immersive art environments, and the most dramatic and unobstructed panoramic views of the New York City skyline available from any publicly accessible point in the world's most iconic urban landscape. Unlike any conventional observation deck, SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is as much a world-class contemporary art experience as it is an elevated viewing destination — the immersive installations of artist Kenzo Digital transforming the space into a sensory environment of extraordinary reflective beauty that multiplies and reframes the Manhattan skyline in endlessly surprising and visually arresting ways. The experience encompasses three distinct and equally extraordinary environments — the indoor glass and mirror immersive art spaces where the city and the sky are reflected and distorted into a visual world of almost infinite depth and beauty, the outdoor glass-enclosed terraces where the Midtown skyline fills every panel of the wraparound glazed walls at dazzling proximity, and the signature LEVITATION experience — glass-floored and glass-walled outdoor pods that extend beyond the building's facade at 1,000 feet above street level, placing guests in suspended transparent glass enclosures with the city visible in every direction including directly below their feet in a physical sensation of vertiginous aerial exposure that is completely unlike anything available at any other observation experience in New York City.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Sun World Fansipan Legend is a mountain attraction located in Sapa, Vietnam, offering access to the iconic Fansipan Peak, known as the “Roof of Indochina.” This destination features one of the world’s longest and highest cable car systems, taking visitors above breathtaking mountain landscapes and c...
globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Fansipan Legend is a mountain attraction located in Sapa, Vietnam, offering access to the iconic Fansipan Peak, known as the “Roof of Indochina.” This destination features one of the world’s longest and highest cable car systems, taking visitors above breathtaking mountain landscapes and cloud-covered valleys. Guests can explore cultural landmarks, temples, and scenic viewpoints at the summit. It is a must-visit for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and photographers. The recommended duration is approximately 3–5 hours or a half-day experience, depending on exploration time and crowd levels. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to enjoy the cable car ride and explore the summit at their convenience. Duration may vary due to weather conditions and queue times. Guests can present their e-ticket or booking confirmation at the cable car station for entry. The journey begins with a scenic cable car ride offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Upon reaching the summit area, visitors can explore temples, walkways, and viewpoints, and may take additional short climbs or funicular rides to reach the peak. Guests can move freely within the area, enjoying the landscapes before descending via cable car to complete the experience.
highlights: Ride a scenic cable car to Fansipan Peak and enjoy breathtaking views of mountains, valleys, and clouds.
Experience one of the world’s longest and highest cable car systems reaching the “Roof of Indochina.”
Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers seeking a unique mountain adventure in Sapa.
Includes cable car access, mountain attractions, temples, and panoramic viewpoints at the summit.
Ideal for travelers and photographers looking to capture stunning landscapes and cultural landmarks.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience never-ending fun at the award-winning water park in Malaysia — Sunway Lagoon! Explore six adventure zones within the park featuring thrilling rides and attractions. Come to the Amusement Park for cowboy rollercoaster action or view the world upside down at the 360-degree pirate ship. Get soaking wet at the Sunway Lagoon's Water Park, where you can surf giant waves at Surf Beach or slide down the vuvuzela, the world's highest and largest water ride. Set foot in Asia's first Nickelodeon-themed park, Nickelodeon Lost Lagoon, and go on splashy adventures with your favorite characters.
highlights: Multi-Park Extravaganza: Sunway Lagoon is a multi-park extravaganza, with 80 attractions spread over 360,000 square meters.
Exciting Rides: There are plenty of fun rides that cater to both children and adults.
Bungee Jumping: Sunway Lagoon offers thrilling facilities like the chance to go bungee jumping.
Kayaking and Archery: You can also learn archery or go kayaking at Sunway Lagoon.
Flying Fox: Experience the thrill of the Flying Fox at Sunway Lagoon.
inclusions: Excluding : Express Pass, pay-per-ride activities (Bungy Jump, G-Force X and Go Kart)
Admission to Sunway Lagoon Theme Park (Water Park, Amusement Park, Wildlife Park, Extreme Park, Scream Park & Nickelodeon Lost Lagoon)

E-load can be topped up at the Ticketing Counter. Unused E-load balance can be refunded on the same day before 7 PM at the Ticketing Counter. When using waterslides, the following are not permitted: jewelry, T-shirts or swimwear with metal decorations, cut-off jeans, and glasses. Slides are used at guests’ own risk. Sunway Lagoon encourages guests to secure valuables. The park is not responsible for lost or stolen items. Guests are responsible for their own belongings. Dangerous items such as bottles, firecrackers, lasers, and other items that may disturb other guests are prohibited inside the venue. Important Notes Sunway Lagoon reserves the right to carry out renovations or upgrading works when necessary. Insurance coverage is applicable (terms and conditions apply). General Park Rules of Sunway Lagoon apply, refer to "http://sunwaylagoon.com/park-rules" How to Get There By LRT: Take the LRT and alight at USJ7 Station. Take the BRT to Sunway Lagoon Station, then walk via the elevated pedestrian walkway for about 5–10 minutes to reach the park entrance. You can also travel by car, public transport, or shuttle service. Please refer to the official website for more details.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Soaring 309 meters above Sydney's cityscape, Sydney Tower Eye (often simply called Sydney Tower) offers unparalleled 360-degree panoramic views. This iconic landmark, situated in the heart of Sydney CBD, is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the city from a breathtaking new perspective. T...
globaltix_product_data.description: Soaring 309 meters above Sydney's cityscape, Sydney Tower Eye (often simply called Sydney Tower) offers unparalleled 360-degree panoramic views. This iconic landmark, situated in the heart of Sydney CBD, is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the city from a breathtaking new perspective. The fully enclosed observation deck allows you to take in the sights no matter the weather. Marvel at iconic landmarks like the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House in stunning detail. On a clear day, you can even see as far as the Blue Mountains, a dramatic range located 80 kilometers away. For the thrill-seekers, Sydney Tower boasts the Skywalk experience. Step out onto an open-air platform hundreds of meters above the ground for a truly exhilarating adventure with breathtaking city panoramas. Whether you choose to sightsee from the observation deck or take the heart-pounding Skywalk adventure, Sydney Tower Eye promises an unforgettable experience that will leave you speechless.
highlights: All-Weather Observation Deck: Enjoy stunning views comfortably year-round.
Witness Sydney's iconic skyline from 309 meters above the city.
Gaze upon this dramatic mountain range 80 kilometers away.
Thrill-seekers can step onto an open-air platform for breathtaking city views.
Iconic Landmarks in Detail: See the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House up close.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Explore the stunning forests of the Huon Valley in South Tasmania above ground in a Tahune Air Walk. globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the stunning forests of the Huon Valley in South Tasmania above ground in a Tahune Air Walk. Towering above both trees and rivers, be amazed by the tranquil forest walk 30-metres into the air and enjoy views spreading right across the valley. You will be truly mesmerised by the final section, with a cantilever sitting 48 metres above the river offering some of the best views you will ever see! This 619-metre walking track is the perfect way to relax and calm the soul in a peaceful and undisturbed environment. Located just a short 90-minutes from Hobart, the Huon Valley also boasts three other forest walks and onsite BBQ areas, making this the perfect location for an adventure filled day out! The Tahune AirWalk is open to explore daily from 9am to 5pm between October and March and from 10am to 4pm April to September. Guests are advised to allow around 50 minutes to explore and make the most of your AirWalk experience.
highlights: Average heights between 20-30 metres
Cantilever 48 metres above the river
Tranquil forest walks

globaltix_product_data.summary: Taipei 101 Observatory offers panoramic views of Taipei City from one of the world's most iconic skyscrapers, located in the heart of the Xinyi District. Formerly the world's tallest building and still considered the world's tallest "green" structure, Taipei 101 rises 508 meters (382 meters to the m...
globaltix_product_data.description: Taipei 101 Observatory offers panoramic views of Taipei City from one of the world's most iconic skyscrapers, located in the heart of the Xinyi District. Formerly the world's tallest building and still considered the world's tallest "green" structure, Taipei 101 rises 508 meters (382 meters to the main observation floor), giving visitors sweeping 360-degree views across the city skyline and surrounding mountains — extending to the Taiwan Strait on clear days. The visitor experience begins with one of the world's fastest elevators, whisking guests from the 5th floor to the 89th-floor Indoor Observatory in just 37 seconds at a speed of 1,010 meters per minute. From there, guests can explore the enclosed 89th-floor deck with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, and — when conditions allow — step out onto the open-air 91st-floor Outdoor Observatory at 440 meters for a breezier, unfiltered view of the city. Engineering enthusiasts can also view the building's massive Tuned Mass Damper, the world's largest, which helps stabilize the tower against high winds and earthquakes. A separate "Skyline 460" add-on ticket grants limited-time access to the 101st-floor open-air platform for those wanting to go even higher. An "Infinite Sky" mirrored installation adds a striking photo opportunity along the visitor path, using reflection and rotation effects to create a kaleidoscope-like visual. Dining options near the observatory cater to a range of tastes, including Taiwanese, Western, vegetarian, and Halal choices.
highlights: Admire spectacular 360-degree panoramic views of Taipei from the 89th-floor indoor observatory.
Visit one of the world's tallest and most iconic skyscrapers.
See the famous 660-ton tuned mass damper that helps stabilize the building.
Capture stunning cityscape photos during both daytime and nighttime visits.
Enjoy a comfortable indoor viewing experience with interactive exhibits and souvenir shops.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Taipei 101 Observatory offers panoramic views of Taipei City from one of the world's most iconic skyscrapers, located in the heart of the Xinyi District. Formerly the world's tallest building and still considered the world's tallest "green" structure, Taipei 101 rises 508 meters (382 meters to the m...
globaltix_product_data.description: Taipei 101 Observatory offers panoramic views of Taipei City from one of the world's most iconic skyscrapers, located in the heart of the Xinyi District. Formerly the world's tallest building and still considered the world's tallest "green" structure, Taipei 101 rises 508 meters (382 meters to the main observation floor), giving visitors sweeping 360-degree views across the city skyline and surrounding mountains — extending to the Taiwan Strait on clear days. The visitor experience begins with one of the world's fastest elevators, whisking guests from the 5th floor to the 89th-floor Indoor Observatory in just 37 seconds at a speed of 1,010 meters per minute. From there, guests can explore the enclosed 89th-floor deck with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, and — when conditions allow — step out onto the open-air 91st-floor Outdoor Observatory at 440 meters for a breezier, unfiltered view of the city. Engineering enthusiasts can also view the building's massive Tuned Mass Damper, the world's largest, which helps stabilize the tower against high winds and earthquakes. A separate "Skyline 460" add-on ticket grants limited-time access to the 101st-floor open-air platform for those wanting to go even higher. An "Infinite Sky" mirrored installation adds a striking photo opportunity along the visitor path, using reflection and rotation effects to create a kaleidoscope-like visual. Dining options near the observatory cater to a range of tastes, including Taiwanese, Western, vegetarian, and Halal choices.
highlights: Admire spectacular 360-degree panoramic views of Taipei from the 89th-floor indoor observatory.
Visit one of the world's tallest and most iconic skyscrapers.
See the famous 660-ton tuned mass damper that helps stabilize the building.
Capture stunning cityscape photos during both daytime and nighttime visits.
Enjoy a comfortable indoor viewing experience with interactive exhibits and souvenir shops.

globaltix_product_data.summary: TeamLab Planets TOKYO is a one-of-a-kind immersive art museum where visitors walk through water, become part of digital artworks, and engage with vibrant, interactive installations. This breathtaking exhibition, created by the renowned art collective TeamLab, blends art, technology, and nature to cr...
globaltix_product_data.description: TeamLab Planets TOKYO is a one-of-a-kind immersive art museum where visitors walk through water, become part of digital artworks, and engage with vibrant, interactive installations. This breathtaking exhibition, created by the renowned art collective TeamLab, blends art, technology, and nature to create a surreal, multi-sensory experience.
highlights: Infinity Spaces: Enter rooms filled with mirrored surfaces and dazzling lights that create a boundless, dreamlike atmosphere.
Walk Through Water: Step into mesmerizing digital environments, including a vast water installation that responds to movement.
Floating Flower Garden: Experience a stunning installation where flowers move and surround you as you walk.
Interactive Artworks: Engage with large-scale digital projections that shift and transform based on your presence.
Sensory Immersion: The exhibits engage all five senses, making the experience truly unforgettable.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Once the admission ticket is activated, it is for personal use only and cannot be resold or shared by multiple people at the same time You are not allowed to re-enter the venue after leaving admission ticket are only valid on the fixed-date. You will not be able to enter without a voucher. Please note that it may take 30-60 minutes to enter the venue; if there is a delay, please wait patiently Wheelchair users must use the wheelchairs provided by the exhibition hall when entering the venue; the number of wheelchairs provided on site is limited and they are standard models without special accessories Please be barefoot in some areas to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker space.The water depth of the exhibits can reach the knee level of an adult. One of the exhibition areas is a mirrored space. If you wear a skirt or wide pants, there is a risk of exposure. It is recommended to wear pants when visiting the exhibition We are not responsible for any personal injury, loss or other problems caused by the facilities during the exhibition. The exhibition facilities are complex and pets such as guide dogs are not allowed to enter. Small lockers are available for free use on site. Locker size is 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H). Please note that some exhibits have flashing lights or loud sound effects. Admission control: In order to disperse the crowds of visitors, teamLab Planets TOKYO will open pre-sale e-tickets for fixed-date and times (each 30 minutes is a time slot). In addition, the number of admission ticket and the number of visitors provided in each time slot will be limited to avoid overcrowding after reopening. Please wear a mask. Everyone is encouraged to follow proper cough etiquette and wash hands frequently or use alcohol disinfectant. Alcohol sprayers are available in many places in the venue. Please feel free to use them. Ventilation and air conditioning equipment in the museum is open 24 hours a day to strengthen cleaning and disinfection operations in the museum "Sunrise and Sunset" exhibition: In case of light rain, the exhibition will remain open for visitors; in case of heavy rain and strong winds such as typhoons, the exhibition may be cancelled Prohibitions & RestrictionsNo outside food or drinks allowed It is prohibited to bring dangerous items such as bottles, firecrackers, lasers, etc. that may disturb or cause inconvenience to other spectators into the venue Smoking and drinking are prohibited. Once found by the staff, you will be asked to leave immediately. You can take photos on site, but filming and live streaming for commercial purposes are strictly prohibited AccessibilityThis activity is not suitable for infant This activity is wheelchair accessible Please refer to the official website for the latest terms of use and precautions. https://www.teamlab.art/e/planets/#notion

options.termsAndConditions: ART AQUARIUM MUSEUM Admisson Ticket (Adult) 1. Photography is allowed in the venue, but do not use tripods, monopods, etc. 2. The use of flash and lighting equipment is prohibited. TeamLab Planets TOKYO Admission Ticket (Youth) Booking notices Prices include taxes. You may need to wait 30–90 minutes for entry. Purchased admission tickets cannot be canceled or refunded. Visitors holding "middle school/high school student" admission tickets may be required to present their student ID and identification documents. Admission tickets are non-transferable. Tickets purchased through resale will not be valid for entry. The operator assumes no responsibility in such cases. Important Notes for Arrival About admission tickets and entry Please arrive at the venue entrance in advance and queue according to the admission time stated on your ticket. The time indicated on the ticket is not the duration of stay allowed inside the venue. When you leave the waiting queue, make sure your companions stay in line. If you're alone, please notify a nearby staff member. Please place the stroller in the designated area before entering. Children under 13 are not allowed to enter alone and must be accompanied by a guardian aged 18 or above. For safety management reasons, pregnant women are unable to experience certain artworks. · Wheelchair users are allowed to enter. However, as wheelchairs cannot access some water-based exhibits, staff will guide you through alternative routes. Visitors using wheelchairs must transfer to the museum's designated wheelchairs before entry. (Note: The quantity of designated wheelchairs is limited, and we appreciate your understanding.) Please be aware that the museum's designated wheelchairs are standard models without any additional restraints. · You may enter with a cane or prosthetic limb. Depending on your situation, some artworks may not be viewable. Before entry, staff will explain the viewing route and rules based on your situation. No re-entry after exit. Once entered, the admission ticket fee is non-refundable. About the venue · In the "Water" area, you must enter barefoot to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker area. · Some artworks are located in water, so please remove your socks or stockings in the locker area beforehand. Even adults may find the water level reaching up to their knees in the artwork. · The water-based works use sodium hypochlorite, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · The venue features water-based exhibits, so we recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next artwork while wearing wet clothing. If you don't have spare clothes, towels are available for loan - please dry your wet clothes before entering the next artwork. Please note that the water area is for viewing purposes only and is not a swimming area. Some exhibits feature mirrored flooring. If concerned about exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap from the museum. Free safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available for use in the facility, with sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please ask staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some experiences cannot be participated in while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. There may be areas with strong lighting stimulation or dimly lit spaces. For safety reasons, customers visiting with children must hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip exhibits, including those with disabilities, children, and their companions. Please consult the staff members if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing baby carriers. The restrooms in the facility are equipped with diaper changing stations. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff members for assistance. When the museum is crowded, staff will guide some visitors who have stayed for an extended period toward the exits. About Carry-on Bags · The pathways between exhibits in the museum are dimly lit, and there are areas with unstable ground or exhibits that involve entering water. Therefore, for safety and hygiene reasons, personal belongings are prohibited in the exhibit areas. If you need to bring essential items for special reasons, please consult with our staff. Free lockers are available inside the facility. You can store your carry-on luggage in the lockers after passing through the entrance gate. Locker dimensions: 23cm wide x 34cm deep x 37cm high. Since there are no additional storage facilities in the museum, we cannot store carry-on luggage that exceeds the above locker dimensions. Luggage exceeding the above locker dimensions will be stored and locked in the stroller parking area. Please be advised in advance. About "Microcosmic Moss Garden - Frozen Colors of Light, Dusk to Dawn" Visits can proceed as usual during light rain. In case of severe weather conditions such as typhoons or heavy rain, the exhibition may be suspended. We appreciate your understanding. Other · This facility shall not be held responsible for any injuries, losses, damages, or other disputes arising from the use of its facilities. ※For other facility notices or precautions, please check the official website at https://planets.teamlab.art/tokyo/#notice. The operator shall not be held responsible for any loss or theft of valuables. We appreciate your understanding. · Please understand that there may be temporary interviews and photography inside the venue. If you do not wish to be photographed, please inform the staff. · Some performances may be unavailable for viewing due to unforeseen circumstances. We appreciate your understanding. Please note if you fall under any of the following circumstances: Individuals who have experienced muscle spasms or loss of consciousness due to light stimulation. People with extreme fear of enclosed spaces, dark areas, or heights People with palpitations and shortness of breath. Pregnant women or those who may be pregnant. Passengers with infants. • Others who are concerned about their own health or physical condition. Prohibited items · Entry for intoxicated or unruly individuals Eating or smoking inside the facility Dangerous items or items deemed unsuitable for entry by the operator. Re-enter after exiting through the exit. · Taking photos or conducting interviews for commercial purposes without prior consent Any animals, including assistance dogs, are allowed ※In addition to the above, admission ticket fees cannot be refunded for visitors who are asked to leave by the operator's judgment. We appreciate your understanding.

globaltix_product_data.description: TeamLab Planets TOKYO is a one-of-a-kind immersive art museum where visitors walk through water, become part of digital artworks, and engage with vibrant, interactive installations. This breathtaking exhibition, created by the renowned art collective TeamLab, blends art, technology, and nature to create a surreal, multi-sensory experience.
highlights: Infinity Spaces: Enter rooms filled with mirrored surfaces and dazzling lights that create a boundless, dreamlike atmosphere.
Walk Through Water: Step into mesmerizing digital environments, including a vast water installation that responds to movement.
Floating Flower Garden: Experience a stunning installation where flowers move and surround you as you walk.
Interactive Artworks: Engage with large-scale digital projections that shift and transform based on your presence.
Sensory Immersion: The exhibits engage all five senses, making the experience truly unforgettable.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Once the admission ticket is activated, it is for personal use only and cannot be resold or shared by multiple people at the same time You are not allowed to re-enter the venue after leaving admission ticket are only valid on the fixed-date. You will not be able to enter without a voucher. Please note that it may take 30-60 minutes to enter the venue; if there is a delay, please wait patiently Wheelchair users must use the wheelchairs provided by the exhibition hall when entering the venue; the number of wheelchairs provided on site is limited and they are standard models without special accessories Please be barefoot in some areas to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker space.The water depth of the exhibits can reach the knee level of an adult. One of the exhibition areas is a mirrored space. If you wear a skirt or wide pants, there is a risk of exposure. It is recommended to wear pants when visiting the exhibition We are not responsible for any personal injury, loss or other problems caused by the facilities during the exhibition. The exhibition facilities are complex and pets such as guide dogs are not allowed to enter. Small lockers are available for free use on site. Locker size is 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H). Please note that some exhibits have flashing lights or loud sound effects. Admission control: In order to disperse the crowds of visitors, teamLab Planets TOKYO will open pre-sale e-tickets for fixed-date and times (each 30 minutes is a time slot). In addition, the number of admission ticket and the number of visitors provided in each time slot will be limited to avoid overcrowding after reopening. Please wear a mask. Everyone is encouraged to follow proper cough etiquette and wash hands frequently or use alcohol disinfectant. Alcohol sprayers are available in many places in the venue. Please feel free to use them. Ventilation and air conditioning equipment in the museum is open 24 hours a day to strengthen cleaning and disinfection operations in the museum "Sunrise and Sunset" exhibition: In case of light rain, the exhibition will remain open for visitors; in case of heavy rain and strong winds such as typhoons, the exhibition may be cancelled Prohibitions & RestrictionsNo outside food or drinks allowed It is prohibited to bring dangerous items such as bottles, firecrackers, lasers, etc. that may disturb or cause inconvenience to other spectators into the venue Smoking and drinking are prohibited. Once found by the staff, you will be asked to leave immediately. You can take photos on site, but filming and live streaming for commercial purposes are strictly prohibited AccessibilityThis activity is not suitable for infant This activity is wheelchair accessible Please refer to the official website for the latest terms of use and precautions. https://www.teamlab.art/e/planets/#notion

globaltix_product_data.description: The world-famous Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre in Hanoi has its roots in an art form that dates back to the 11th century. The tradition of water puppet theater stems from a time when rice paddy fields were flooded and villagers would create entertainment by standing in waist-deep water with the puppets performing over the water. Using large rods to support the puppets it appeared as if they were moving across the water with the puppeteers hidden behind a screen.
highlights: Authentic Art Form: Experience Vietnam’s unique water puppetry, a 1,000-year-old tradition performed on a live water stage.
Cultural Storytelling: Watch folk tales, legends, and rural life come alive through handcrafted puppets and skilled puppeteers.
Live Orchestra: Enjoy traditional Vietnamese music with live singers and instruments enhancing every scene.
Immersive Setting: Sit in a theater designed for close-up views of the water stage, creating an engaging and intimate atmosphere.
Easy & Family-Friendly: Short, engaging show ideal for all ages, perfect for adding a cultural highlight to your Hanoi visit.

options.name: Atlantis Balloon Entry Ticket
options.description: A Spectacular Balloon Ride Over Palm Jumeirah The Palm Jumeirah is one of Dubai’s signature engineering marvels. This world-famous man-made island is shaped like a palm with 17 fronds, a 10-mile-long crescent, and a one-mile-long trunk, all enriched by luxurious residential homes, hotels, restaurants, and shopping malls. The Dubai Balloon Ride at Atlantis offers the island’s most stunning and comprehensive views, as you soar 300 meters high during the experience. Witness the Panoramic View of Palm Jumeirah and the Coastline The Dubai Balloon adventure begins at Poseidon’s Watchtower, within Atlantis Aquaventure, one of the world’s largest water parks. It is a tethered flight, which allows you to see the majestic Atlantis, The Palm, the Royal Atlantis, and other jaw-dropping sights across Palm Jumeirah from a thrilling yet highly safe perspective. Besides the magnificent views of the coastline and the aquamarine sea, you can catch glimpses of the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab, the Burj Khalifa (the tallest building on the planet), and Ain Dubai (the world’s largest observation wheel) on a clear day. Shop and Relax at the Lounge The balloon ride is your best chance to snap pictures of the city’s gorgeous landscape. After the balloon flight that lasts 10 minutes, you can visit the retail store to purchase merchandise and souvenirs to remember your sky-high session. Depending on your ticket choice, head to the lounge area to unwind, absorb the region’s tranquility, and relish complimentary refreshments.

globaltix_product_data.description: In the heart of Osaka's vibrant energy, THE SUMO HALL HIRAKUZA OSAKA captivates visitors from around the world with its unique sumo cultural experience. This entertainment venue has become both a new highlight of Osaka's nightlife and a gateway to understanding traditional Japanese culture. Upon entering, guests are immediately immersed in the powerful atmosphere of sumo. On stage, retired grand sumo wrestlers deliver breathtaking performances that recreate the intensity and excitement of sumo matches. Visitors can witness the profound history and distinctive charm of sumo up close, learn about its rules, prohibited moves, and winning techniques through English commentary, and enjoy humorous insights into the wrestlers' daily lives. Beyond the performances, THE SUMO HALL HIRAKUZA OSAKA offers engaging interactive experiences. Guests can step onto the dohyo (sumo ring) for practice sessions or photo opportunities with the wrestlers, experiencing the sport's unique appeal firsthand. The venue also features an area selling original merchandise and Kansai souvenirs, allowing visitors to take home a piece of this extraordinary experience. With its authentic cultural immersion, spectacular shows, and diverse activities, THE SUMO HALL HIRAKUZA OSAKA stands as one of Osaka's must-visit attractions. Here, every visitor gains a deep appreciation for the rich heritage and captivating essence of Japanese sumo culture.
highlights: Watch live performances by retired professional sumo wrestlers.

Step onto the dohyo and take memorable photos with the wrestlers.

Experience one of Osaka's most unique cultural entertainment attractions.

globaltix_product_data.name: The Top Penang
globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience one of Penang’s most iconic attractions at The TOP Penang, a modern indoor entertainment hub located in the heart of George Town. This multi-level attraction combines an observation deck, theme park elements, and interactive exhibits all under one roof. Guests can enjoy breathtaking city...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience one of Penang’s most iconic attractions at The TOP Penang, a modern indoor entertainment hub located in the heart of George Town. This multi-level attraction combines an observation deck, theme park elements, and interactive exhibits all under one roof. Guests can enjoy breathtaking city views from the Rainbow Skywalk, explore fun and educational zones, and experience a variety of family-friendly activities, making it an ideal destination for visitors of all ages. The recommended visit duration is approximately 2 to 4 hours, depending on the number of attractions included in your ticket and your pace of exploration. The experience is generally self-paced, allowing guests to explore each level and attraction at their own leisure. Actual duration may vary based on crowd levels, weekends, public holidays, or special events taking place at the venue. Upon arrival, guests can enter using a direct QR code or redeem their tickets at the designated counter, depending on the booking type. After entry, visitors can proceed through different zones, starting from indoor attractions such as interactive exhibits, Jurassic-themed experiences, and family-friendly rides, before heading up to the highlight observation deck. During the visit, guests can enjoy a variety of experiences including the Rainbow Skywalk, glass-bottom walkway, observation deck, and multiple themed attractions. The journey typically flows from indoor entertainment zones to the rooftop level, where guests can take in panoramic views of Penang’s skyline. Visitors are free to explore at their own pace, capture memorable photos, and enjoy a complete entertainment experience from start to finish.
highlights: Enjoy observation deck, skywalk, indoor theme park & interactive exhibits in one exciting multi-level attraction.
Walk the Rainbow Skywalk with glass floors and take in panoramic views from Penang’s tallest tower.
Perfect for families, couples, and groups seeking fun, photos, and unique city experiences.
Tickets may include entry to multiple zones, rides, and themed attractions depending on selected package.
Explore at your own pace with a self-guided experience suited for all travel styles.
