This exclusive exhibition bares all, from his flying machines to his most parodied paintings. Discover the ingenious mind of the original Renaissance man at the Leonardo da Vinci Experience.Leonardo da Vinci is well-known for the . But more than just a painter, some of his sketched-out ideas anticipated the most revolutionary inventions of our time, including the bicycle, the helicopter, the crossbow, and the parachute.One of the five halls here is dedicated to these studies. Another has 22 reproductions of his famous paintings, including the and her enigmatic smile.Get to know the breadth of the great man's genius via audio recordings, military machines, interactive displays, and even holograms. If you're worried that all this stimulation may tire you out, don't worry. As the great man himself once said, "learning never exhausts the mind".

globaltix_product_data.description: Legong Dance, also known as Legong Kraton, is one of Bali’s most revered classical court dances, once performed exclusively within royal palaces. Originating in the 19th century, it is renowned for its intricate choreography, expressive gestures, and fast-paced movements executed by young female dancers adorned in elaborate gold costumes. Accompanied by a powerful gamelan orchestra, the dance narrates an ancient royal tale of love, conflict, and fate, blending elegance, precision, and storytelling into a mesmerizing cultural performance now enjoyed at cultural stages across Bali.
highlights: Experience the essence of Bali's cultural heritage through the visually stunning Legong Dance

atch in awe as young female performers demonstrate incredible agility and grace, executing the demanding poses and quick movements of the Legong Dance

Originating in the 19th century, the dance is famous for its intricate choreography, expressive hand and eye movements, and fast, precise steps performed by young female dancers dressed in elaborate gold costumes. Accompanied by the powerful sounds of a traditional gamelan orchestra, the dance tells an ancient royal story of love, conflict, and destiny. Combining elegance, precision, and storytelling, the Legong Dance is now widely performed at cultural venues across Bali, offering visitors a mesmerizing glimpse into the island’s rich cultural heritage.

globaltix_product_data.description: With its unrivaled art collection and harrowing history, Lobkowicz Palace gives you the best of Prague all under one beautifully baroque roof. Book your ticket to Prague’s top-ranked museum and get a free audio guide narrated by the Lobkowicz family themselves!As Prague Castle’s only private wing, Lobkowicz Palace offers an exclusive look into true Czech opulence and the fascinating historical drama that comes with it.Get the inside scoop on the amazing story of this 16th-century landmark, which includes true tales of priests thrown out of windows, devastating Nazi occupation, and a communist takeover — all told by the royal family members themselves. We won’t ruin the ending, but don’t worry, it’s a happy one.Ranked Prague’s number one museum by TripAdvisor, Lobkowicz Palace is home to world-famous paintings you’ll definitely recognize. You’ll also get to peek at original classical manuscripts such as Mozart’s hand-annotated score of and Beethoven’s groundbreaking .The Panorama audio tour offers a guided walk through breathtaking 180° view of the city, including some of Prague’s most famous landmarks; Prague Castle, St. Vitus Cathedral, Old Town Square, and Charles Bridge.

globaltix_product_data.description: Go the extra mile in magical Prague with a visit to this 16th-century palace - the only private facility inside Prague Castle. Hear a special midday concert and see stunning city panoramas, ceramics spanning five centuries, arms and armor, even hand-annotated manuscripts by Beethoven, Haydn and Mozart!Soak up the midday classical music performed in the Baroque concert hall of Lobkowicz Palace, the only private building in Prague Castle, and the #1-ranked Prague museum on TripAdvisor. Don't forget to look up at the painted, 17th-century fresco ceiling. In the museum, check out five centuries of ceramics, and a pretty sweet collection of arms and armor. You'll also get to lay your eyes on original, hand-annotated manuscripts by no less than Mozart and Beethoven. And it's not just music and artifacts, as this spectacular locale also has a heavyweight art collection. See masterpieces by Canaletto, Brueghel the Elder, Cranach and Velázquez. You'll have an audio guide, complete with narrations by two generations of the Lobkowicz family the Chief Curator. How's that for a personal touch?The Lobkowicz Palace café offers you homemade delicacies and fantastic views of the city from the panoramic terrace.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Save your beach getaways and sun tans for last and dive head first for an exhilarating outdoor adventure at Skytrex in Langkawi! The amazing team behind Skytrex cooked up the most challenging obstacles for all ages. Each trail showcases different difficulty levels with a range of challenges along th...
globaltix_product_data.description: Save your beach getaways and sun tans for last and dive head first for an exhilarating outdoor adventure at Skytrex in Langkawi! The amazing team behind Skytrex cooked up the most challenging obstacles for all ages. Each trail showcases different difficulty levels with a range of challenges along the circuits: Eagle Thrill, and Extreme Challenge. Enjoy a fun and relaxed action in the Little Legend Adventure with the many zipline journey from tree to tree and take on a balancing obstacle atop vertical and horizontal bridges in the midst of the jungle. At the Eagle Thrill, dare to conquer height-induced obstacles such as the Flying Fox, Plank Bridge and many more. Not for the faint-hearted, the Island Extreme houses 35 notorious tasks that would make even the biggest thrill-seeker tremble in fear. Participants have to go through the Saddle, Cargo Net Up, X Bridge, Surf Board so it's best to stay hydrated throughout the entire course! The forest's natural and misty environment makes for the suspense of each Skytrex challenge, there's always plenty of room to keep the obstacles interesting. Complete with safety briefing, gear and equipment, and a friendly English speaking instructor, Skytrex Adventure is worth every penny if you're up for an extraordinary physical challenge!

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Description Titanic: The Artifact Exhibition takes you on a historical journey through the Titanic's story, from its maiden voyage to its tragic end. Each guest will receive a replica boarding pass, allowing you to imagine yourself as a passenger on this journey. Explore over 300 artifacts from the Titanic and catch a glimpse of its past and the lives of those on board. Stroll through galleries showcasing the ship's splendid features, such as the grand staircase and living room suites. Head to the seaside promenade deck to feel the Atlantic breeze and even touch a real iceberg. Don't miss the chance to see "The Big Piece," a massive 3-ton hull fragment that remains one of the largest recovered pieces of the ship's wreckage. How to use Please present your mobile confirmation at the ticket office to redeem your admission ticket. The ticket office is located at 7324 International Drive, Orlando FL 32819 Standard admission tickets are valid at any time during the following periods: Sunday–Thursday – 10 AM–6 PM (last entry at 5 PM) Friday & Saturday – 10 a.m. – 5 p.m. (last entry at 4 p.m.) Ticket pick-up location 7324 International Drive, Orlando FL 32819 Ticket pick-up time 10:00~20:00(Jan 1–21 (Mon–Thu, Sun): Entry ends at 7:00 PM);10:00~18:00(Jan 22–Mar 10 (Mon–Thur, Sun): Entry ends at 17:00);10:00~20:00(Mar 11–Sep 2 (Mon–Thur, Sun): Entry ends at 7:00 PM);10:00~18:00(Sep 3–Oct 6 (Mon–Thur, Sun): Entry ends at 17:00);10:00~20:00(Oct 7–Dec 31 (Mon–Thu, Sun): Entry ends at 19:00);10:00~17:00(Jan 1–Dec 31 (Fri–Sat): Entry ends at 4:00 PM) Location of use and Time of use are the same as Ticket pick-up location and Ticket pick-up time

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Public transportation options are available nearby Suitable for all physical fitness levels This tour is available only to guests aged 12 and over. Guests under 12 years old are not permitted inside the sumo stable. If a guest under 12 is found, we may have to deny participation without a refund. The tour will start promptly, and guests are required to arrive on time. Please note that late arrivals will not be able to join the tour, and no refunds or rescheduling will be provided for missed tours. Please be aware that most sumo stables do not provide chairs, and guests are expected to sit directly on tatami (straw mat flooring). Some locations on the tour may not be accessible by wheelchair or stroller. Guests must strictly follow the rules of each sumo stable. If a guest behaves disruptively or disrespects the stable's regulations, the stable reserves the right to refuse entry or participation without a refund. Please note that only tatami areas are accessible inside the stable; all other areas are off-limits. If necessary, guests are allowed to leave the stable before the end of practice; however, please understand that re-entry will not be permitted once you have exited. Photography during the practice is subject to each sumo stable's policy. Depending on the day, taking photos of the wrestlers or with the wrestlers may not be allowed. Depending on the number of participants, the group may be divided and assigned to different stables. Seating inside the stables is on a first-come, first-served basis; later arrivals may be seated farther from the front. Please understand that sumo stables may cancel or adjust their practice schedule at the last minute based on the wrestlers' condition or tournament commitments. In case of cancellation by the stable, a full refund will be issued promptly. The length of the practice session may vary, which could cause the tour to end earlier or later than the estimated time. Please use the restroom before the tour begins, as restroom access may not be available during the practice. Reservation changes or requests made on the day of the tour cannot be accommodated. In some cases, we may request a change to your tour time or date depending on the availability of the sumo stables. Japan's climate has become more extreme, with summer temperatures reaching up to 40°C (110°F) and winter lows dropping to -5°C (20°F). Please dress appropriately for the weather. There is no separate entrance fee for attending the sumo morning practice.

Admire the s...
globaltix_product_data.description: Take a break from the loud Bali adventures and head over to peaceful Toya Devasya Hot Springs. Enjoy their collection of natural hot spring pools that are loaded with natural minerals. Take advantage of their different healing properties and spend a day soaking them all up at the pools. Admire the stunning nature views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur as well. Resting within the ancient confines of the Batur caldera resides a hidden gem—a transformative hot spring drawing waters from the Earth’s depths, holding ancient therapeutic secrets. This hydrotherapy source, born of geological evolution, emerges as a significant boon for skin health, renowned for its revitalizing sulfur water properties.
highlights: Seven separate hot spring pools and two non-hot spring pools are available for you to enjoy at Toya Devasya Hot Spring Waterpark.
You will soak up a lot of natural minerals since the water is heated from deep inside the soil!
Toya Devasya Hot Spring's infinity pool with a view of the lake is excellent for healing the mind, body, and spirit.

globaltix_product_data.description: Immerse yourself in Bali’s rich cultural heritage with the mesmerizing Kecak Fire Dance performance at Karang Boma Uluwatu. Set against the dramatic backdrop of a cliffside overlooking the Indian Ocean, this unique experience combines art, tradition, and nature in a breathtaking setting. As the sun sets, the sky transforms into vibrant hues, creating the perfect ambiance for the performance. The rhythmic chanting of the dancers, the crackling of the fire, and the enchanting storyline based on the Ramayana epic will leave you spellbound. Located at Uluwatu’s Sunset Point, this venue offers panoramic views of the ocean and the horizon, making it one of Bali’s most iconic destinations. Whether you’re a culture enthusiast or simply seeking an unforgettable evening, this experience is not to be missed. Your ticket includes entry to the performance, giving you access to one of Bali’s most sought-after cultural events. Don’t miss the chance to witness this captivating blend of tradition and natural beauty. Attention: Kecak Karang Boma Cliff Uluwatu is located about 2 km before the Uluwatu Temple Kecak venue. It offers a better sunset view because the location is higher than the Uluwatu Temple Kecak stage. There is no need to queue, and seating is guaranteed for all visitors.
highlights: Experience Bali’s rich cultural heritage in a dramatic oceanfront setting.
Witness the captivating Kecak Fire Dance performance inspired by Ramayana epic.
Explore Uluwatu’s stunning oceanfront with panoramic Indian Ocean views.
Enjoy stunning sunset views from the cliffside at Karang Boma Uluwatu.
Perfect for couples, families, and solo travelers seeking a unique experience.

globaltix_product_data.summary: This is a real working film studio with a theme park built on top of it, and the Studio Tour remains the thing that sets it apart. A tram carries you through active backlots — crashed airliners, flooded streets, the facades of a hundred films you half-recognise — before plunging into King Kong and F...
globaltix_product_data.description: This is a real working film studio with a theme park built on top of it, and the Studio Tour remains the thing that sets it apart. A tram carries you through active backlots — crashed airliners, flooded streets, the facades of a hundred films you half-recognise — before plunging into King Kong and Fast & Furious sequences on giant screens. Beyond the tour, the park divides across two levels. Above sit The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, with Hogwarts castle rising over Hogsmeade, and Super Nintendo World, where a wearable band lets you punch blocks and collect coins across the whole land. Below are Jurassic World, Transformers and the Revenge of the Mummy coaster. Everything is packed tight into a hillside site, so you move between eras and franchises in a few minutes' walk. Just outside the gate, Universal CityWalk carries the evening on with restaurants, cinemas and live music.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Embark on an exclusive, semi private tour of the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Raphael Rooms, and historic Papal Apartments in Rome, enjoying priority access to all sites with a maximum of just 10 guests. Delight in the breathtaking masterpieces from the vast collection curated by the Catholic Ch...
globaltix_product_data.description: Embark on an exclusive, semi private tour of the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Raphael Rooms, and historic Papal Apartments in Rome, enjoying priority access to all sites with a maximum of just 10 guests. Delight in the breathtaking masterpieces from the vast collection curated by the Catholic Church over centuries. Your journey begins as you step into the Vatican Museums, a treasure trove of some of the Western world’s most celebrated art. Wander through the awe-inspiring Gallery of the Maps, Gallery of the Tapestries, and Gallery of the Candelabra, and stand in the presence of iconic sculptures like the Belvedere Torso and Laocoön. Admire the architectural elegance of the Greek Cross Room, the artistic brilliance of the Raphael Rooms, the historic grandeur of the Old Papal Apartments, and so much more. The highlight of your tour awaits in the Sistine Chapel, where Michelangelo’s genius shines through his monumental works. Gaze in wonder at the dramatic Last Judgment adorning the altar wall and the iconic Creation of Adam gracing the magnificent ceiling fresco, leaving an indelible mark on your memory. After visiting the Sistine Chapel, we will take a tour guide passage out of the Chapel (when passage is open) to finish the tour directly in front of St. Peter's Basilica, where you will have an explanation of the Basilica from the outside. All guests are then free to enter the church afterwards if you chose, wait times may vary to enter the Basilica. Discover the enduring wonders of the Eternal City, tracing her origins from the grandeur of classical antiquity, through the delicate artistry of the Renaissance, to the lavish baroque opulence of the Counter-Reformation.

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with a skip-the-line entrance ticket. Visit the Raphael Rooms, Gallery of Maps and immerse yourself into the fascinating world of art and historical artefacts. After meeting your host (NOT Tour Guide), you will enter the main hall without waiting in line and have the opportunity to explore the museums at your own pace. Discover the marble sculpture Laocoön and His Sons at the Museum Pio-Clementino, one of the renowned museum spaces within the complex. Next, see the famous Belvedere Torso, Round Hall, and the Raphael Rooms. Admire the unique theme and frescoes depicting various scenes and subjects. Continue to the Sistine Chapel, renowned for the remarkable frescoes by Michelangelo. You will be amazed by the masterpieces of Michelangelo, Botticelli, Ghirlandaio, and other Renaissance artists. Marvel at the beautiful collection of ancient sculptures, Renaissance paintings, tapestries, manuscripts, and archaeological findings. Enjoy a remarkable visual journey into the world of the Renaissance at your own pace.

options.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel Skip-the-Line Entry Ticket
options.description: Enjoy priority access to the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with this skip-the-line entry ticket. After meeting your host (not a tour guide), you will enter the museums without waiting in the general admission line and explore at your own pace. Discover the vast collection of art and historical treasures housed within the Vatican Museums. Visit highlights such as the Raphael Rooms, the Gallery of Maps, and the impressive Pio-Clementino Museum, where you can admire masterpieces like Laocoön and His Sons and the famous Belvedere Torso. Explore the Round Hall and other remarkable galleries filled with ancient sculptures, Renaissance paintings, tapestries, manuscripts, and archaeological artifacts. Continue your visit to the Sistine Chapel and marvel at Michelangelo’s breathtaking frescoes, including the iconic ceiling and The Last Judgment. You will also see works by renowned Renaissance artists such as Botticelli and Ghirlandaio. This skip-the-line entry ticket allows you to enjoy a self-guided visit and immerse yourself in one of the world’s greatest art collections at your own pace. Meeting point Please check in at our office located at Via Sebastiano Veniero 74. Look for the sign outside that reads "Inside Out Italy." Your host will then escort you to the Vatican Museum entrance, assist you through the security check, and provide insights on what to visit. More information click HEREHow to Get There Take Metro Line A to Ottaviano-San Pietro-Musei Vaticani station. Several bus lines also stop nearby, including 49, 32, 81, and 982. If driving, parking is available in the vicinity, but it's limited.

globaltix_product_data.name: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc
globaltix_product_data.summary: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s first and largest semi-wildlife conservation park, offering visitors a unique chance to discover hundreds of animal species from around the world in spacious natural habitats. Spread across a vast protected area in northern Phu Quoc, the safari combines open zoo...
globaltix_product_data.description: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s first and largest semi-wildlife conservation park, offering visitors a unique chance to discover hundreds of animal species from around the world in spacious natural habitats. Spread across a vast protected area in northern Phu Quoc, the safari combines open zoo experiences, animal encounters, educational activities, and conservation programs, making it a perfect destination for families and nature lovers. The experience includes walking through themed zones, watching animal shows, and joining the popular safari bus tour where visitors can observe wild animals such as giraffes, zebras, rhinos, and tigers roaming freely in open environments. The park is designed to provide close-up wildlife experiences while promoting awareness of conservation and biodiversity. For a more exclusive adventure, the Night Safari offers a rare opportunity to explore the park after dark. Visitors travel through specially curated safari routes to observe nocturnal animals in their active hours, enjoy guided storytelling, and experience the unique atmosphere of the wildlife park under the stars. The night program creates a different perspective on animal behavior, making it one of the most memorable experiences in Phu Quoc.
highlights: Vietnam’s first open safari – Explore one of the country’s largest wildlife conservation parks.
Safari bus experience – Observe animals roaming freely in spacious natural habitats.
Animal shows & feeding – Enjoy interactive performances and feeding sessions.
Diverse wildlife – See hundreds of rare and exotic species from around the world
Night Safari adventure – Discover nocturnal animals and a unique after-dark wildlife experience.
